english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The Amurites have no ancient history, no glorious empire in the Age of Magic to harken back to or trace their lineage from. In terms of civilizations, the Amurites are newcomers on the world stage. Nevertheless, they are a force to be reckoned with, feared by some, and respected by all. Part of that respect stems from the tremendous magical power the Amurite armies command, but no small part of it stems from the incredible story of their genesis.[PARAGRAPH:1]The Amurites call themselves the Children of Kylorin. According to their own legends, the arrival of the archmage Kylorin saved the Amurite people from obscurity, or possibly extinction, during the Age of Ice. Not even the Amurites know exactly why Kylorin picked these people as his chosen folk, but they maintain that it was because of a particular strength of character.[PARAGRAPH:1]Whatever the reason, when Kylorin appeared he changed the fortunes of the tiny, struggling clan that had been the Amurites. For years he lived in their midst, taking new wives as his old ones died of old age or in childbirth, leading the Amurites to a level of organization and advancement unrivalled by any other nation in the Age of Ice. Generations came and went, but Kylorin remained a constant, working towards some arcane goal with the Amurites as his willing and joyous tools. Whether through magic or sheer force of will, he remained young throughout.[PARAGRAPH:1]Until, one day, Kylorin strode out of his home. His face had aged many years, terrible purpose shone in his once soft and kindly eyes, and a magnificent blade hung faintly glowing by his side. With no farewells and no apologies, he went forth into the icy wastes and never came back. Soon after, the Thaw began.[PARAGRAPH:1]He had, however, left behind a powerful gift: his children. Through the years there had been quite a few, and they all carried latent magical abilities. Though the advancement made during the guardianship of the immortal wizard started leaking away during the Thaw, Kylorin's powers remained. Throughout the years, the children of Kylorin intermarried with the rest of the Amurites, and the abilities spread, making the Amurites the civilization that is most magnificently in touch with the magical currents of Erebus.[PARAGRAPH:1]This link has affected every aspect of Amurite life. They run their nation like a great magical school, training as many of their young as possible in, at the very least, basic magic skills. Their schools are so famous, they even attract those with magical abilities from other corners of the globe to join their ranks. The archmages and headmasters of the schools and universities act like an aristocracy in a nation that does not really have one, wielding great political power beyond the walls of their institutions.[PARAGRAPH:1]As with any large collection of scholars, the Amurites are mired in scholarly bureaucracy, the most insipid form of administrative quagmire known to man. The archmages, like professors, are frequently involved in petty squabbles over obscure matters that develop into personal feuds. Positions and knowledge are jealously guarded and hard to obtain; potential rivals are stonewalled at every turn. It is easy to become a mage in the service of the Amurites, but it takes a shrewd, powerful and unscrupulous practitioner of magic to rise to the apex of magical power.[PARAGRAPH:1]Above all, the Amurites have come to worship magic for its own sake. Their fascination with all aspects of magic is so deep that they do not feel hindered by petty alignments and concepts of "good" and "evil." Any avenue of magic can be explored, but some branches, like necromancy, are governed by strict laws and regulations, in order to prevent abuse and disasters. Justice for a mage who ignores these laws and starts dabbling in the regulated branches without obtaining the necessary permission is merciless, final, and in keeping with their fascination with the uses of magic, rather spectacular. No possibility is left for a repeat offense.[PARAGRAPH:1]Since the Amurites do not feel themselves confined by the alignments most nations follow, they are treated with a healthy amount of distrust by good and evil civilizations. Evil civilizations dislike the regulation of the dark and chaotic spheres, good civilizations are worried that they are not forbidden entirely. While not specifically hated by any, they have trouble making truly close allies. However, they don't feel they need any. As long as they are left in peace to conduct their magical experiments, they are happy, and wise rulers respect that. Those few who have crossed the Amurites and felt the fire of their arcane might have no desire to repeat the experience. Many have not been left the option.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]阿姆莱特人没有古老的历史，没有可供追溯血脉、引以为傲的魔法时代辉煌帝国。就文明而论，阿姆莱特人是登上世界舞台的后来者。然而，他们是一股不容小觑的力量，为一些人所惧，为所有人所敬。这份敬意，一部分源于阿姆莱特军队所掌握的惊人魔力，但也有相当一部分源于他们那不可思议的起源故事。[PARAGRAPH:1]阿姆莱特人自称凯洛林之子。据他们自己的传说，正是大魔法师凯洛林的到来，在寒冰时代把阿姆莱特人从默默无闻、甚至覆灭的命运中拯救了出来。就连阿姆莱特人自己也说不清凯洛林为何选中这群人作为他的选民，但他们坚称，那是因为一种特殊的品格力量。[PARAGRAPH:1]无论出于何种缘由，凯洛林现身时，改变了这个当年弱小挣扎的阿姆莱特小部族的命运。多年间他与他们同住，旧妻因年老或难产而逝，他便另娶新妇，把阿姆莱特人带到了寒冰时代任何他国都无从匹敌的组织与进步高度。世代更迭，凯洛林却始终如一，把心甘情愿、欣然效命的阿姆莱特人当作工具，为某个神秘的目标而努力。无论是靠魔法还是纯粹的意志力，他始终保持年轻。[PARAGRAPH:1]直到有一天，凯洛林大步走出了他的居所。他的面容苍老了许多，曾经温柔慈祥的双眼中如今燃着可怕的决意，一柄华美的战刃隐隐发光地悬在他身侧。他没有告别，也没有致歉，径直走入冰封的荒原，再未归来。不久之后，消融便开始了。[PARAGRAPH:1]然而，他留下了一份强大的馈赠：他的孩子们。这些年来孩子已有不少，他们全都承载着潜藏的魔法天赋。尽管在这位不朽巫师庇护期间取得的进步在消融中渐渐流失，凯洛林的力量却留存了下来。岁月流转，凯洛林之子与其余阿姆莱特人通婚，那份天赋随之扩散，使阿姆莱特人成为最能宏大地感应埃瑞布斯魔力潮汐的文明。[PARAGRAPH:1]这份联系影响了阿姆莱特生活的方方面面。他们把整个国度当作一所宏大的魔法学校来经营，尽可能多地训练年轻人，至少掌握基础的魔法技艺。他们的学校声名远播，甚至吸引着世界各个角落有魔法天赋之人前来加入。学校与大学的大魔法师、校长们，在这个原本并无贵族的国度里俨然一个贵族阶层，在其学府高墙之外行使着巨大的政治权力。[PARAGRAPH:1]与任何庞大的学者群体一样，阿姆莱特人也深陷学术官僚主义的泥潭——那是人类已知最索然无味的行政泥沼。大魔法师们如同教授，常为一些晦涩的琐事争执不休，进而演变成私人恩怨。地位与知识被小心提防、难以获取；潜在的对手在每一处都被阻挠。在阿姆莱特人麾下成为一名法师并不难，但要登上魔力的巅峰，则需要精明、强大而不择手段的魔法修行者。[PARAGRAPH:1]最重要的是，阿姆莱特人已然为魔法本身而崇拜魔法。他们对魔法各个层面的痴迷如此之深，以至于并不觉得受制于“善”与“恶”这类琐碎的阵营划分。魔法的任何门径皆可探索，但某些分支——如死灵术——受严格的律法与规章管辖，以防滥用与灾祸。对于那些无视这些律法、未经许可便涉足受管制分支的法师，制裁是无情的、终局的，并且与他们对魔法用途的痴迷相称——相当地惊心动魄。绝不给再犯留下任何可能。[PARAGRAPH:1]由于阿姆莱特人不觉得自己受制于多数国家所遵循的阵营，善良与邪恶的文明都对他们抱有相当程度的戒备。邪恶文明厌恶他们对黑暗与混沌领域的管制，善良文明则担忧这些领域并未被彻底禁绝。尽管无人特别憎恨他们，他们却难以结下真正亲密的盟友。然而，他们并不觉得自己需要盟友。只要能安然无扰地进行魔法实验，他们便心满意足，明智的统治者也会尊重这一点。那少数曾与阿姆莱特人为敌、领教过其奥术之火的人，再无重温那份经历的欲望。而许多人，则根本没有再来一次的机会。

english: [TAB]The Balseraphs have access to the most unusual units, the [LINK=UNIT_TASKMASTER]Taskmaster[\\LINK] who can capture slaves in any civic option, [LINK=UNIT_HARLEQUIN]Harlequins[\\LINK] that can cast chaos spells, [LINK=UNIT_FREAK]Freaks[\\LINK] who start mutated, and [LINK=UNIT_MIMIC]Mimics[\\LINK] who steal promotions for the units they defeat. Balseraph spellcasters can create [LINK=UNIT_PUPPET]Puppets[\\LINK] which can cast their spells of their owners.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Kylorin was the greatest mage who ever lived, unrivaled in versatility or insight. There were some individuals, though, who surpassed him in raw talent. Jealousy was never a fault of Kylorin, even at his most depraved, and he sought out those with particular aptitude to take as his personal pupils. Perpentach was one of his students, a master of mind magic before he even knew it. He could control minds without even trying. Doing so frequently at a young age took a toll on his sanity. Kylorin healed his mind when he found him, and with Perpentach's unrivaled powers at his disposal, his increasingly dark empire never once faced the threat of revolt. Until Kylorin himself saw what he, and by his hand most of mankind, had sunk to. Kylorin tried to reform Patria, but doing so brought its ruin, for the most powerful people on the planet, his pupils, had been molded by him into cold-hearted instruments of control and oppression, and few of them wanted to take the limits their master then tried to impose. When Kylorin went to stop Perpentach, he almost lost his life for it. He did the only thing he could do to survive, stunning Perpentach by undoing his previous work, and Perpentach's mind was flooded with all the thoughts and personalities he had acquired with his magic. [PARAGRAPH:1] Unwilling to kill the man he had corrupted, Kylorin locked Perpentach in the Tower of Eyes, a dungeon deep in the wastelands guarded by mindless golems. There he would have spent the rest of his mad days had it not been had for a circus caravan that wandered close enough for Perpentach to gain control. This was the start of the Balseraph nation, as Perpentach used the circus people to carry his mind to a nearby village and brought them under his control to free him from his prison. This would surely have led to another confrontation with his master, had not the Age of Ice intervened. Perpentach lasted the age by taking over the body of a young man when he aged, and he and the circus people and their descendants, either controlled by his magic or subdued by it, lasted that dire age by hiding from the Illian White Hand. When his old master freed the world from Mulcarn's grasp and warmth and prosperity returned to Erebus, Perpentach set out to rebuild his empire. His madness does not cripple him, but his realm is like no other, whimsical and deadly at once. [PARAGRAPH:1] It is not easy to fool the master of mind magic, but the Sheaim are not strangers to the arcane, and a spy from their realm was able to pose as a courtesan in Perpentach's mad court. She was found, though not before conceiving a child with Perpentach, a girl who was kept and raised by puppets, imps, djinn and other summoned creatures. Keelyn has little concept of mortality or morality, but she does have powerful summoning at her disposal, making her a dangerous wildcard in the politics of Erebus. Perpentach has never publicly acknowledged her, due to madness or perhaps some scheme.
chinese: [TAB]巴尔塞拉弗族能使用最不寻常的单位：可在任何政体下俘获奴隶的 [LINK=UNIT_TASKMASTER]监工[\\LINK]，能施放混沌法术的 [LINK=UNIT_HARLEQUIN]小丑[\\LINK]，一出场便已变异的 [LINK=UNIT_FREAK]畸变人[\\LINK]，以及会窃取所击败单位晋升的 [LINK=UNIT_MIMIC]模仿师[\\LINK]。巴尔塞拉弗的施法者能创造 [LINK=UNIT_PUPPET]人偶[\\LINK]，替其主人施放法术。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]凯洛林是有史以来最伟大的法师，其博识与洞见无人能及。不过，也有个别人在纯粹的天赋上胜过他。妒忌从来不是凯洛林的缺点，即便在他最堕落之时也是如此，他遍寻天赋异禀之人，收为亲传弟子。普宾塔克便是他的学生之一，在自己都尚未察觉时便已是心灵魔法的大师。他能毫不费力地操控他人的心智。年少时频繁施展此术，令他的神智付出了代价。凯洛林寻得他时治愈了他的心智，而有了普宾塔克无与伦比的力量供其驱使，凯洛林那日益黑暗的帝国从未有过一次叛乱之虞。直到凯洛林亲眼看清了自己、以及经他之手令大半人类沦落到的境地。凯洛林试图改革帕特里亚，此举却招致其覆灭，因为星球上最强大的那些人——他的门徒——已被他塑造成冷酷无情的操控与压迫工具，其中鲜有人愿意接受他们的师父此时试图强加的约束。当凯洛林前去阻止普宾塔克时，几乎因此丧命。他只能做那唯一能保命之事：撤销自己先前的手法，令普宾塔克陷入震荡——普宾塔克的心智顿时被他借魔法获得的一切思绪与人格所淹没。[PARAGRAPH:1] 凯洛林不忍杀死这个被自己腐化的人，便把普宾塔克锁进了眼之塔——一座深藏于荒原、由无心魔像看守的地牢。他本会在那里度过余下的疯癫岁月，若不是一支马戏篷车恰巧游荡到近处，让普宾塔克得以夺取控制。这便是巴尔塞拉弗族的开端：普宾塔克借马戏团众人把自己的心智带到邻近村庄，将村民纳入掌控，助自己逃出牢笼。此举本必将再度引来与其师父的对决，若非寒冰时代及时降临。普宾塔克在自己衰老时夺取一名年轻男子的躯体，就这样熬过了那个时代；而他与马戏团众人及其后裔——或受其魔法操控，或为其所慑服——则靠着躲避伊利安的白手，熬过了那段凄厉的岁月。当他昔日的师父将世界从穆卡恩的掌控中解放、温暖与繁荣重返埃瑞布斯时，普宾塔克便着手重建自己的帝国。他的疯癫并未令他残缺，但他的国度却与众不同，既异想天开，又致命凶险。[PARAGRAPH:1] 要愚弄心灵魔法的大师并非易事，但塞安人对奥术并不陌生，他们派出的一名间谍得以在普宾塔克疯癫的宫廷中扮作名妓。她最终被识破，却在此之前已与普宾塔克孕育了一个孩子——一个由人偶、小恶魔、灯神及其他召唤生物养大的女孩。琪琳对生死或道德几无概念，却掌握着强大的召唤之力，令她成为埃瑞布斯政局中一张危险的变数之牌。普宾塔克从未公开承认过她，或因疯癫，或出于某种谋算。

english: [TAB]The Bannor are a good all-around civ who shine once embarking upon a total war. Their Crusade civic will give them troops on the field and decreased war weariness.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The Bannor started with a handful of people, trapped in hell during the fall of Braduk but rescued by Sabathiel, an angel in Junil's service. In exchange for their salvation, the spirits bound themselves and their descendants to ceaselessly battle the forces of chaos and disorder. As Sabathiel led the honorable spirits forth into the light, they formed the vanguard in a devastating war against the Clan of Embers, even more powerful then than they are today. Throughout the entire Age of Rebirth the Bannor waged brutal and merciless war not only on the Clan, but on all who would not submit to law and order.[PARAGRAPH:1]Throughout this war of liberation and extermination, these heroes of an ancient age forged conquered, allied, and submitting tribes, cities, and nations into a human empire which, with the aid and guidance of Sabathiel, may stand firm even against the looming apocalypse, when unequaled evil is loosed upon Erebus. [PARAGRAPH:1]This continuing Holy War permeates every part of their society, leaving it almost totally militarized. For the Bannor, there is no clear line between religion, family, and politics. They apply a frightening religious fervor to the art of war, and their obsession with order makes even the peasant regiments among the best drilled of all the empires. All men are trained from childhood in the arts of war-hand-to-hand combat, archery, self defense, strength, and agility. Unlike most other societies, there are plenty of possibilities for rising through the ranks through bravery and skill, a fact which inspires as much if not more fighting fervor than the religious element.[PARAGRAPH:1]Because they need to be defended and ready at all times, outlying villages are more like forts, every farm is a small castle, the cities are huge garrison towns but also centers of trade, religion, and diplomacy. Few men are without scars from battle and the women are strong-willed and hardened. They know that the children they raise may one day be lost in battle, and they also know that one day the war may come to them. It is a rare woman among the Bannor that cannot handle a sword. [PARAGRAPH:1]A central part of understanding the fabric of Bannor society is understanding the split between estates and "free land." The estates are enormous tracts of land, almost sub-kingdoms, under the rule of an Order, a Family or one of those peculiarities of the Bannor: a Hereditary Order-a religious order with members exclusively from one clan. Centered on a stronghold or small fortified city, the main function of the estates is to provide the necessary resources to field one Order or Family division, the powerful and highly dedicated fighting forces that make up the feared backbone of the Bannor armies.[PARAGRAPH:1]The lion's share of the land in the Bannor empire is the "free land." The villages and cities that occupy and make a living off this land must, in addition to paying taxes and organizing their own defenses, provide a number of soldiers, fully trained and equipped, according to the wealth of the settlement. Although the Orders and Families are the spearhead and armored fist of Bannor armies, "free land" conscripts provide the bulk forces that are needed to carry a battle.[PARAGRAPH:1]By far the most numerous of the estate-holders, the non-hereditary Orders will take fighters from all across the world, all nations and races. Those deemed worthy in prowess and intelligence are taught in the ways and language of the Bannor and then join the fighting forces on the same footing as native Bannor.[PARAGRAPH:1]The hereditary Orders are in reality families that have founded or taken over control of an Order. All the major positions are held by and passed down from father to son, uncle to nephew, like any usual aristocratic title. It is one of the few options a rich non-noble family has of gaining an estate and the power and responsibility that comes with it.[PARAGRAPH:1]The noble Families all trace their lineage back to one of the spirits that Sabathiel set free. They use this holy heritage to legitimize their enormous power, and it is the reason the priesthood tolerates their existence and their meddling in the running of things. There are very few Families, but every one of them wields as much power and wealth as an Order. However, the priesthood keeps these secular powerhouses under careful and strict control, lest they attempt to change the fabric of Bannor society.[PARAGRAPH:1]The highly-trained and well-equipped men who fight in the professional divisions of the Orders and Families come from a variety of backgrounds and fight for any number of reasons: Some do it for money or status, some few do it for glory or personal revenge, but most do it because they truly believe they are on the front line of the war against Evil.[PARAGRAPH:1]As any Bannor priest could tell you, the war fought by the Bannor is far more complicated than a simple Good-Evil battle. The priesthood, under the guidance of Sabathiel (or so they claim) decide who is an enemy. Although they have yet to fight a civilization that conforms to some kind of law and sense of justice and compassion, few who can avoid it dare cross the Bannor, lest they be "damned" and added to the list of civilizations that must be taught to repent.[PARAGRAPH:1]The focal point of the entire Bannor Empire is their capital, centered around the Bannor Palace, The Halls of Sabathiel. Although still recognizably a garrison city, it is also a sprawling, international metropolis matched by few other cities in Erebus. This is where the Orders have their headquarters, this is where the Families meet to discuss affairs of state, and this is where people come to consult with the priesthood. People of all races flock to the city to swell the ranks of the Orders, the Halls of Sabathiel have a constant stream of visitors coming to pay tribute or ask favors of his priests, and the bazaars and markets attract traders from far and wide, catering to the needs of a multiracial, multinational and multicultural army and administration.[PARAGRAPH:1]Sabathiel, the mythical ruler of the Bannor, unwilling to set foot upon Erebus and break the letter or the spirit of the Compact, is said to reside deep within the recesses of his Halls, watching, guiding, teaching, and warding over the Bannor, urging them on but unable to physically manifest. He is a shadow king, never seen by his subjects but always a haunting figure, ever present in their consciousness. Their battlefield commanders are much more present figures to most Bannormen, Capria being the best example, who as a young girl led her people as they stepped from hell, and soon grew in honor and authority through the end of the Age of Ice and dawn of the Age of Rebirth.[PARAGRAPH:1]In this day, there are those even among the Bannor, and even more so among their enemies, who whisper that both Sabathiel and his original spirits are naught but legends invented by a militant priesthood looking for ways to legitimize their rule. Whatever the truth of the matter, the fact is that in the Age of Rebirth, the Bannor must rely on human flesh and cold steel, not angels and spirits, to bring Law to the dark corners of the world.
chinese: [TAB]班诺尔人是一个全面而均衡的文明，一旦投入全面战争便大放异彩。他们的十字军政体会为其在战场上提供军队，并降低厌战情绪。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]班诺尔人始于寥寥数人，他们在布拉杜克陷落时被困于地狱，却为萨巴曦尔——一位效命于朱尼尔的天使——所救。作为获救的交换，这些灵魂将自身及其后裔束缚于一项使命：永不停歇地与混沌无序之力作战。萨巴曦尔引领这些高尚的灵魂步入光明，他们组成先锋，投入一场对余灰部落的毁灭性战争——那时的余灰部落，比今日还要强大。整个重生时代，班诺尔人不仅对余灰部落，更对一切不肯臣服于律法与秩序者，发动了残酷无情的战争。[PARAGRAPH:1]在这场解放与灭绝之战中，这些古老时代的英雄把被征服的、结盟的、臣服的部族、城市与国家，锻造成一个人类帝国。有萨巴曦尔的援助与指引，这个帝国或许能坚守如磐，即便面对那即将来临、无与伦比的邪恶降临埃瑞布斯的末日浩劫。[PARAGRAPH:1]这场延续不断的圣战渗透进他们社会的每一处，令其几乎彻底军事化。对班诺尔人而言，宗教、家庭与政治之间并无清晰的界线。他们把令人畏惧的宗教狂热注入战争的技艺，而对秩序的执迷，使得就连他们的农民军团也跻身各帝国中操练最精良之列。所有男子自幼便接受战争技艺的训练——肉搏、射箭、自卫、力量与敏捷。与多数社会不同，凭勇气与技艺晋升的机会比比皆是，这一事实所激起的战斗热忱，即便不比宗教因素更甚，也丝毫不逊。[PARAGRAPH:1]由于他们时刻都需自卫戒备，边远村庄更像是堡垒，每座农场都是一座小城堡，城市则是庞大的驻军之城，同时也是贸易、宗教与外交的中心。鲜有男子身上不带战伤，女子则意志坚强、饱经磨砺。她们知道，自己养育的孩子有朝一日或将战死沙场，也知道战火有朝一日或将烧到自己身上。在班诺尔人中，不会用剑的女子实属罕见。[PARAGRAPH:1]要理解班诺尔社会的结构，一个核心是理解“采邑”与“自由领”之间的划分。采邑是庞大的地块，几近于附属王国，由一个“骑士团”、一个“家族”，或班诺尔人那些奇特产物之一：一个“世袭骑士团”——成员全部出自同一氏族的宗教骑士团——所统辖。采邑以一座要塞或设防小城为中心，其主要职能是提供必要的资源，供养一个骑士团或家族的军团，即那支强大而高度献身、构成班诺尔军队令人畏惧之中坚的战斗力量。[PARAGRAPH:1]班诺尔帝国绝大部分土地是“自由领”。占据并赖此为生的村庄与城市，除缴纳赋税、自行组织防务外，还须依据聚落的财力，提供若干名训练有素、装备齐全的士兵。尽管骑士团与家族是班诺尔军队的矛头与铁拳，“自由领”的征召兵却提供了赢得战役所需的主力部队。[PARAGRAPH:1]非世袭骑士团是采邑持有者中数量最多的，他们从世界各地、各个国家与种族招募战士。凡被认定勇武与才智堪当者，皆受教于班诺尔的规矩与语言，随后与本族班诺尔人平起平坐地加入战斗序列。[PARAGRAPH:1]世袭骑士团实则是创建或接管了某个骑士团的家族。一切要职皆由父传子、伯传侄地世代承袭，如同寻常的贵族头衔。这是富裕的非贵族家族获得采邑、以及随之而来的权力与责任的少数途径之一。[PARAGRAPH:1]贵族家族无不将血脉追溯至萨巴曦尔所解放的某个灵魂。他们借这份神圣的传承令其庞大的权力合法化，这也是祭司阶层容忍其存在、容忍其干预政务的缘由。家族为数极少，但每一个所掌握的权力与财富都不亚于一个骑士团。然而，祭司阶层对这些世俗强权严加管控，以防他们试图改变班诺尔社会的结构。[PARAGRAPH:1]那些在骑士团与家族的职业军团中作战、训练有素且装备精良的男子，出身各异，作战的理由五花八门：有人为钱财或地位，少数人为荣耀或私仇，但多数人是因为他们真心相信，自己正站在对抗邪恶之战的最前线。[PARAGRAPH:1]任何一位班诺尔祭司都会告诉你，班诺尔人所进行的战争远比单纯的善恶之争复杂。祭司阶层在萨巴曦尔的指引下（或者说，他们如此宣称）决定谁是敌人。尽管他们尚未与某个恪守某种律法、正义感与悲悯之心的文明交过手，凡能避则避者鲜有敢冒犯班诺尔人的，以免被打入“该死者”之列，加进那份必须被教会悔改的文明名单。[PARAGRAPH:1]整个班诺尔帝国的焦点，是他们的都城，以班诺尔宫——萨巴曦尔之殿——为中心。尽管它仍明显是一座驻军之城，却也是一座蔓延扩张的国际大都会，埃瑞布斯少有城市能与之匹敌。这里是骑士团的总部所在，是家族商议国是之地，也是人们前来求教祭司之所。各族之人涌入此城，充实骑士团的行列；萨巴曦尔之殿终日有络绎不绝的访客前来朝拜、或求告其祭司；集市与市场吸引着四面八方的商人，满足着一支多种族、多民族、多文化的军队与行政机构之所需。[PARAGRAPH:1]萨巴曦尔，这位班诺尔人传说中的统治者，不愿踏足埃瑞布斯而违背契约的字面或精神，据说深居于其殿堂的隐秘深处，注视、指引、教导、守护着班诺尔人，激励他们奋进，却无法亲身显现。他是一位影子之王，其臣民从未见过他，却始终是一个萦绕心头的身影，永远存在于他们的意识之中。对多数班诺尔人而言，他们的战场指挥官是远为鲜活的形象，凯布瑞尔便是最好的例子——她还是个小女孩时便引领她的族人踏出地狱，并很快在寒冰时代的终结与重生时代的黎明中，声望与权威与日俱增。[PARAGRAPH:1]时至今日，即便在班诺尔人中，尤其在他们的敌人中，有人低声议论：萨巴曦尔及其最初的那些灵魂，不过是好战的祭司阶层为令其统治合法化而编造的传说。无论真相如何，事实是，在重生时代，班诺尔人必须依靠血肉之躯与冰冷的钢铁，而非天使与灵魂，才能把律法带到世界的黑暗角落。

english: [TAB]The Calabim's main strength lies in their [LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]vampire[\\LINK] units, which gain great power by feasting on citizens in their cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The Age of Ice almost spelt the end of the vampires. When the vast sheets spread over the once-fertile land, their main source of food, humanity, started to become scarce and ever more concentrated in small tribes. Fearing a fate worse than death-the shadowy almost-death of a vampire deprived of fresh nourishment for centuries-most vampires tried to cling to the ever-shrinking communities of survivors. A lone vampire trapped in a small group of people quickly switches from hunter to prey. One by one, the vampires were dispatched to the afterlife.[PARAGRAPH:1]Of those few vampires who escaped the hunters, most took to a feral existence, living off whatever inferior blood they could scavenge in the wild, preying off the occasional human unfortunate enough to be caught alone. But some wise few realized that the only path to survival lay in making the natural transition from parasite to master. [PARAGRAPH:1]Led by the ancient siblings Alexis and Flauros, a small group of surviving vampires "adopted" a rag-tag tribe of humans. Using their powers as immortals, unaffected by cold, or exhaustion, gifted with incredible vision and speed, they made sure the tribe had plenty of food. And all they asked in return was an endless, expendable resource: A few drops of blood. But a vampire's powers are not restricted to supernatural senses and strength-their great power is in the mind.[PARAGRAPH:1]Slowly but surely, using their natural powers of guile and persuasion, and dangling the "Dark Gift" as bait to lure the best and strongest humans into helping them, the vampires wormed their way to the top of their little society. Few wished to oppose them and risk losing their valuable hunting skills. Those who did had accidents, or simply disappeared.[PARAGRAPH:1]When the humans finally realized what was happening, it was too late. They were trapped in a hellish situation, little more than cattle for a growing class of parasitic nobility, and they had been trapped there of their own free will.[PARAGRAPH:1]Now, Flauros and Alexis are the Grand Prince and Princess of a depraved and hopeless society of bloodpets and slaves, controlled by the Grand Broods, the vampire families that rule each city as their own personal estate farms, living in decadent luxury, and sating their lust for blood at will. The Calabim are the apex of vampire evolution, an abomination that is the natural enemy of all holy nations.
chinese: [TAB]卡拉比姆人的主要优势在于他们的 [LINK=PROMOTION_VAMPIRE]吸血鬼[\\LINK] 单位，这些单位靠吞食城中居民而获得强大力量。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]寒冰时代几乎为吸血鬼画上了句号。当广袤的冰盖蔓延过曾经肥沃的土地，他们的主要食物来源——人类——开始变得稀缺，且愈发聚集于零星的小部族之中。吸血鬼惧怕一种比死亡更可怖的命运——数百年得不到新鲜滋养的吸血鬼那如影随形、半死不活的状态——大多数吸血鬼试图依附于那些不断萎缩的幸存者社群。一头困于小群人类之中的孤身吸血鬼，会迅速从猎手沦为猎物。吸血鬼被一个接一个地送入来世。[PARAGRAPH:1]在那少数逃过猎手的吸血鬼中，大多过起了野兽般的生活，靠在荒野中搜刮到的任何劣质血液苟活，偶尔捕食那些不幸落单的人类。但也有少数睿智者意识到，唯一的生路在于完成从寄生者到主宰的自然蜕变。[PARAGRAPH:1]在古老的兄妹艾莉柯西丝与弗劳诺斯的率领下，一小群幸存的吸血鬼“收养”了一个乌合之众般的人类部族。他们运用作为不朽者的力量——不惧严寒，不知疲倦，天赋异常的视觉与速度——确保部族有充足的食物。而他们所求的回报，不过是一种取之不尽、可随意挥霍的资源：几滴血。但吸血鬼的力量并不局限于超凡的感官与体魄——他们真正的伟力，在于心智。[PARAGRAPH:1]吸血鬼运用其与生俱来的诡诈与说服之力，把“黑暗馈赠”当作诱饵，引诱最优秀、最强壮的人类为其效力，缓慢却坚定地蛀蚀爬升到这个小社会的顶端。鲜有人愿意与他们作对，冒险失去自己宝贵的狩猎技艺。那些胆敢作对的，不是遭遇“意外”，便是干脆失踪。[PARAGRAPH:1]当人类终于意识到发生了什么时，为时已晚。他们身陷炼狱般的处境，沦为一个不断壮大的寄生贵族阶层眼中不过比牲畜略强的存在——而他们竟是出于自己的自由意志走进这陷阱的。[PARAGRAPH:1]如今，弗劳诺斯与艾莉柯西丝是一个由血畜与奴隶构成、堕落而绝望的社会的大公与女大公，这个社会由“大血族”统治——那些吸血鬼家族把每座城市当作自家的私人庄园农场，过着颓靡奢华的生活，随心所欲地满足自己对鲜血的渴望。卡拉比姆人是吸血鬼进化的顶点，一个天生与一切神圣国度为敌的可憎存在。

english: [TAB]The Clan has access to the cheapest, but not always the most powerful, units in the game. Starting at peace with the barbarians and with access to Fire mana allows them a strong early and mid-game start which may wane if they haven't established themselves well by the time other civilizations start making the more-advanced units and heroes.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Fire was the tool Kylorin used to cleanse the rot from Patria, for Bhall had given her righteous followers gifts to rival those sorcerous powers gained first from Ceridwen. The passionate fire goddess was a force for good. Those who loved justice and mercy could use her power to counter the wicked mages Kylorin had trained. But she fell to the wily whispers of Agares, God of Despair, raining fire on the just and unjust alike in a terrible day heralding the end of the Age of Magic. Once devout men of many nations, the orcs were transformed, cursed and enraged when Bhall fell. The holy city of Braduk had the goddess pass through as she fell from the Heavens, taking many of those who loved goodness and trapping them in Hell. Half the city was rendered a flaming pit, but those people who remained, in touch with the fiery spirit of Bhall, were twisted into the orcs. Mulcarn, Bhall's former nemesis, took this chance to claim dominion over Erebus, and the orcs, along with the rest of the world, were ushered into the Age of Ice. [PARAGRAPH:1]They survived, huddled around the fires of Braduk the Burning, and developed barbarous rituals and a savage warrior culture, raiding struggling human settlements. The holy scepter of the High Priest of Bhall was affixed with a brutal axe head by the Orc warlord Orthus, and many nascent tribes fell to its power. One people stood up to the orcs, though. Those who had been taken to Hell with Bhall were freed by Sabathiel, the Archangel of Junil late in the Age of Ice, as Mulcarn's contest with Kylorin drew near. These battle-hardened warriors were a true test for the savage orcs, but the orcs were too numerous for the Bannor to defeat, living in the relative luxury amidst the fires of Braduk. Jonas was a fierce warlord of great renown among the orcs, who resented being subordinate to the matriarchal priesthood of Bhall. He staged a coup against the high priestess, but Bhall took notice of her people again, and humbled Jonas, making him her priest. Captured as a babe, the orc Sheelba was raised among the Bannor as a human girl but was spurned and taken in by the orc clans, united under Jonas's Ember Banner. Her insights into civilization have the potential to allow these clans to rise above the petty barbarous orc tribes led by the likes of Orthus, even as their sheer strength and Jonas's cunning allows them to tear down the human civilizations.
chinese: [TAB]余灰部落能使用游戏中最廉价、但未必最强大的单位。他们一开局便与蛮族和平相处，且能取用火焰能量，这让他们拥有强劲的前期与中期开局；但若在其他文明开始造出更高级的单位与英雄时仍未站稳脚跟，这份优势可能会衰退。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]火，是凯洛林用来涤除帕特里亚腐朽的工具，因为巴尔曾赐予她正直的信徒足以匹敌那些最初得自塞丽德雯的巫术之力的天赋。这位热情的火焰女神曾是一股向善的力量。热爱正义与慈悲之人，能借她的力量对抗凯洛林训练出的邪恶法师。但她堕入了绝望之神阿加雷斯狡黠的低语，在一个宣告魔法时代终结的可怕日子里，向义人与不义者一视同仁地降下烈火。曾是众多国家虔诚信徒的兽人，在巴尔陨落时被变形、被诅咒、被激怒。神圣之城布拉杜克，正是女神自天界坠落时途经之处，她把许多热爱良善之人带走，困于地狱。半座城市化作一片燃烧的火坑，而那些留存下来、与巴尔炽烈之魂相通的人，则被扭曲成了兽人。巴尔昔日的宿敌穆卡恩趁机夺取了对埃瑞布斯的统治权，兽人连同世间万物，一同被推入寒冰时代。[PARAGRAPH:1]他们幸存了下来，簇拥在“燃烧的布拉杜克”的火堆旁，发展出野蛮的仪式与凶悍的战士文化，劫掠挣扎求生的人类聚落。巴尔大祭司的神圣权杖被兽人军阀俄耳托斯装上了一枚残暴的斧头，许多新生的部族败于其威。然而，有一族人挺身反抗兽人。那些随巴尔被带入地狱之人，在寒冰时代末期、穆卡恩与凯洛林的角逐临近之时，为朱尼尔的大天使萨巴曦尔所解放。这些身经百战的战士对野蛮的兽人是一场真正的考验，但兽人数量太多，班诺尔人无从击败——他们生活在布拉杜克的火焰之中，相对而言颇为优渥。约拿斯是兽人中声名显赫的凶悍军阀，他不满于屈居巴尔那母权制祭司阶层之下，遂对女祭司长发动政变，但巴尔再度垂顾她的子民，令约拿斯谦卑，收他为自己的祭司。兽人希尔芭尚在襁褓时被俘，在班诺尔人中作为一个人类女孩被养大，却遭排斥，转而被兽人氏族收留——那些氏族已在约拿斯的余灰旗帜下联合。她对文明的洞见，有望让这些氏族超越俄耳托斯之流所率领的野蛮兽人小部族；与此同时，他们纯粹的蛮力与约拿斯的狡诈，也足以让他们撕碎人类的文明。

english: [TAB]Doviello are well-set for early conquest, with strong starting units and few building requirements for their units. Should they carve a strong empire early, they may continue to thrive as Erebus heats up.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Charadon was a young boy raised in the harsh Age of Ice. Whether this accounts for his savagery or some otherworldly taint is a question for the ages, but it did allow him and his tribe to survive. He copied the tactics of the wolf packs preying on his people, taking the strongest under his wing, sharing with those who helped his tribe survive but abandoning those who slowed it down. Other men and women joined this tribe, their alternatives being submission to Mulcarn's White Hand priesthood or a cold lonely death. Only the Doviello were free and thriving in the heart of the winter, but the cost of this was any noble aspects of their humanity. The ruling Illians left the Doviello alone to prey on those tribes that gained Mulcarn's enmity. Eventually the Doviello clashed with Kylorin's Amurites, and the savage wolf was forced to heel. Kylorin bested them, turning them against their former master. As the Age of Rebirth dawns, the Doviello wonder if they made a mistake. They did what they felt they had to do to survive, but by allowing the Age of Ice to end they have endangered their way of life. The wolf is adaptable, but also cunning, and should they sniff out Auric Ulvin's plans a path to their old dominance may arise. [PARAGRAPH:1]Mahala seeks to reawaken the spirit of their founder, Charadon, whose leadership would renew the Doviello's savage ties, though a path of strength through civilization is also open to the Doviello's current pack leader.
chinese: [TAB]多维洛人极擅前期征服，起始单位强悍，且其单位所需的建筑前置极少。若能在前期开辟出一个强盛的帝国，随着埃瑞布斯逐渐回暖，他们或许能继续繁荣。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]卡拉登是在严酷的寒冰时代长大的少年。这究竟是他残暴之性的缘由，还是某种异界的污秽所致，是个千古之谜，但这确实让他和他的部族得以幸存。他效仿捕食其族人的狼群战术，把最强壮者收于羽翼之下，与助部族存续者分享，却抛弃拖累部族者。别的男女也加入了这个部族，他们别无选择——要么臣服于穆卡恩的白手祭司阶层，要么孤独地冻死。唯有多维洛人在寒冬的核心自由而昌盛，但代价是丧失了他们人性中一切高尚的部分。统治天下的伊利安人放任多维洛人去捕食那些招致穆卡恩仇恨的部族。多维洛人最终与凯洛林的阿姆莱特人发生冲突，这头野蛮的狼被迫俯首。凯洛林击败了他们，令其反戈对付昔日的主人。当重生时代破晓，多维洛人不禁怀疑自己是否犯了错。他们做了自认为为求生存必须做的事，但任由寒冰时代终结，却危及了他们的生活方式。狼善于适应，却也狡黠；若他们嗅出奥里克·尤尔文的图谋，一条重返昔日霸权的路径或将浮现。[PARAGRAPH:1]玛哈拉试图重新唤醒他们的奠基者卡拉登的精神，其领导将重续多维洛人野蛮的纽带；不过，一条借文明壮大自身的道路，也向多维洛现任的族群首领敞开着。

english: [TAB]The Elohim have a couple of ways to stay safe in the dangerous world of Erebus, their hero and world spell. And when they conquer cities, in war or peace, their wise rule allows them to build units exclusive to the civilization that built those cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]In the Age of Dragons the gods waged war through proxies, fierce Dragons, wild Krakens, and armies of lesser angels and demons and, rarely, face to face. In either case, the destruction caused was cataclysmic.[PARAGRAPH:1]Immanuel Logos was a follower of Sirona, Goddess of Wisdom. He ruled a small tribe in her name, dispensing wisdom and providing shelter for her followers. Until one day he observed her army, a phalanx of titans, marching upon a stronghold of Aeron. The armies met in a field worked by a group of subsistence farmers. When the battle ended, the armies were tattered, but the bystanders were worse, broken in body, fields destroyed, and despondent of spirit. It was a scene played out countless times, as dragons crushed struggling settlements when they clashed or holy fire rained down upon those caught in the middle. Immanuel believed in his goddess, but he could no longer stand on the sidelines, nor confine his care to his own people.[PARAGRAPH:1]Off came his regal symbols, and he tossed aside his sacred spear for the last time. He gathered orphaned children in his arms, and doled comfort to the dying. Sirona watched this noble leader leave her service but did not forbid him leaving. She knew that for humanity to survive, they needed more than someone fighting on their behalf. They needed care and shelter through the days of heavenly warfare.[PARAGRAPH:1]Thus was born an order of monks. Before the compact, they had no permanent home. They traveled the world, tending to the battered and broken under the guidance of Immanuel and his successors, who took his name to show their spiritual heritage and authority. Their service attracted other kind-hearted souls to their numbers, and they became one of the most trusted groups in the eyes of men and angels. Thus, when the compact was forged, they were the only mortals who witnessed the handing of the Godslayer to the legend Finner. The agreement of the gods to withdraw from direct combat in mortal realms was met by the world Erebus herself with great joy, and at that spot seven fir trees were born to stand witness. Before departing, Sucellus tasked the order of the Elohim with tending to this and other sacred sites, some symbols of great importance, some fonts of power.[PARAGRAPH:1]As the kingdoms of men arose in the Age of Magic, the Elohim continued this mission, peacefully when possible, with force when necessary. Warlords who searched for clues to the location of Finner's tomb, wizards who coveted an angel's tears for his magics, and others sought the Elohim's knowledge, secrets that they often died to protect. The warrior monk tradition was begun in these trying times, men who carried no weapon, so anathema was warfare to them, but could subdue marauders within the blink of an eye. The monk's purity was a ward against the more vile forces that sought to harm their charges.[PARAGRAPH:1]Then came Bhall's fall and Mulcarn's breach of the Compact. The Elohim lost contact with many of their sacred sites, abandoning them to the elements and wild men. But they returned to their original mission, and traveled to desperate communities, tending to disease and enshrining dying knowledge in chants and stories so when rebirth came, it would be swift and complete. As in the Age of Dragons, their numbers swelled with those inspired by their example, and they became not just an order, but a nation.[PARAGRAPH:1]Today that nation has emerged into the sunlight of rebirth. Einion Logos is the head of the ancient order of Elohim, a position of unequaled respect. He is ancient himself, but wishes to live however long enough to see his followers reclaim their shrines. Gariel the Strong was the King of the Elohim nation which shelters the order. He led his people out of the Age of Ice, but his reign was cut short by illness and passed to Ethne the White, his daughter who must now withstand the trials of the Age of Rebirth.
chinese: [TAB]埃洛希姆人在危机四伏的埃瑞布斯世界中有两种保全自身的手段：他们的英雄与世界法术。而当他们征服城市时，无论战时还是和平时期，其贤明的统治都能让他们建造那些建立了这些城市的文明所专属的单位。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]在巨龙时代，众神借代理人开战——凶猛的巨龙、狂野的海妖、成群的次级天使与恶魔——偶尔也会正面交锋。无论哪种情形，所造成的破坏都是灾难性的。[PARAGRAPH:1]伊曼纽尔·罗格斯是智慧女神希柔娜的信徒。他以她之名统治着一个小部族，播撒智慧，为她的信徒提供庇护。直到有一天，他目睹了她的军队——一支泰坦组成的方阵——向艾伦的一座据点进军。两军在一群自耕农劳作的田野上交锋。战斗结束时，军队损兵折将，而旁观者的处境更惨：身体残破，田地尽毁，心灰意冷。这一幕曾无数次上演——巨龙交战时碾碎挣扎求生的聚落，或是圣火降临于夹在中间者的头上。伊曼纽尔信仰他的女神，却再也无法袖手旁观，也无法把自己的关怀局限于自己的族人。[PARAGRAPH:1]他脱下王者的象征，最后一次抛开他神圣的长矛。他把失去父母的孩子揽入怀中，给临终者以慰藉。希柔娜注视着这位高尚的领袖离她而去，却未曾禁止他离开。她知道，人类若要存续，需要的不仅仅是有人为他们而战。他们需要在天界战火纷飞的岁月里得到关怀与庇护。[PARAGRAPH:1]于是，一个僧侣团诞生了。契约缔结之前，他们没有固定的居所。他们游历世界，在伊曼纽尔及其继任者的指引下照料伤残与破碎之人——继任者们承袭他的名号，以彰显其精神传承与权威。他们的服务吸引了其他心怀善念的灵魂加入，他们成为在人与天使眼中最受信赖的群体之一。因此，当契约缔结之时，他们是唯一见证“弑神者”被交予传奇人物芬纳的凡人。众神同意撤出凡间领域的直接交战，此约为埃瑞布斯世界本身以极大的喜悦所接纳，在那处地点诞生了七棵冷杉，立此为证。临行前，苏塞鲁斯将守护此地及其他圣地的重任托付给埃洛希姆之团——那些圣地，有的是意义重大的象征，有的是力量之泉。[PARAGRAPH:1]随着人类的王国在魔法时代兴起，埃洛希姆人延续着这一使命，能和平时便和平，需动武时则动武。那些搜寻芬纳陵墓线索的军阀，那些觊觎天使之泪以助其魔法的巫师，以及其他人，都觊觎埃洛希姆人的知识——那些他们往往以死守护的秘密。武僧的传统始于这些艰难的岁月，那是一群不持任何武器之人，战争于他们而言如此可憎，却能在眨眼之间制服劫掠者。僧侣的纯洁，是抵御那些企图伤害其所护之人的更邪恶之力的护佑。[PARAGRAPH:1]随后便是巴尔的陨落与穆卡恩对契约的破坏。埃洛希姆人与许多圣地失去了联系，任其荒废于风雨与野人之手。但他们回归了最初的使命，奔赴绝望的社群，救治疾病，将行将失传的知识铭刻于圣歌与故事之中，好让重生来临时，来得迅速而完整。一如巨龙时代，他们的队伍因受其榜样感召之人而壮大，他们不再仅仅是一个团，而成为一个国家。[PARAGRAPH:1]今日，这个国家已步入重生的阳光之下。艾尼恩·罗格斯是古老的埃洛希姆之团的首领，一个享有无上敬重的职位。他自己也已年迈，却愿再活得够久，好见其信徒重夺他们的圣所。强者加瑞尔曾是庇护此团的埃洛希姆之国的国王。他引领族人走出寒冰时代，但他的统治因病痛而中断，传给了白袍艾斯妮——他的女儿，如今她必须经受重生时代的考验。

english: [TAB]The Grigori are the only civilization that gains the powerful Adventurer unit. The Adventurer is a Great Person and Hero that can be upgraded into almost any human unit. The Grigori use these customizable heroes as elite warriors, and they can grow into some of the best units in the game. This is balanced with an inability to gain the benefits of a state religion.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Cassiel was an angel in the service of Dagda. He spent the Age of Dragons protecting the men who hid from the might of the warring gods around them. It was his counsel that led Dagda to create and sign the Compact, but Cassiel felt the Compact did not go far enough. He wanted the gods to retreat entirely, to let the men form their own world. When the Compact allowed the gods to battle through men, Cassiel abandoned Dagda's service and began his own crusade to lead men away from a war that has little to do with them. This action gained him few allies among the gods or the humans who serve them. A few brave souls were attracted to Cassiel's creed, though he refused to offer any divine boons or even direct leadership to them. His followers must adhere to his ideas and lead themselves. Throughout the ages the cities of the Grigori offered safe haven for those who wanted to lead their own lives. The wars of the Age of Magic and the scarcity of the Age of Ice took its toll on them like every other land, but they sought help not from the heavens but from themselves.[PARAGRAPH:1]In the Age of Rebirth, Cassiel still stands, offering others ideas and guidance but little more, and some brave few are still drawn to his ideas. Among those who seek asylum in his lands are the Luonnotar, who teach that none of the gods acting on Erebus is worthy of worship, but only one greater god who made them. Cassiel certainly agrees with the first part of this, though he isn't forthcoming on the second.
chinese: [TAB]格利高里族是唯一能获得强大冒险者单位的文明。冒险者是一位伟人兼英雄，可升级为几乎任何人类单位。格利高里人把这些可定制的英雄当作精锐战士，他们能成长为游戏中最出色的单位之一。作为平衡，他们无法获得国教的种种裨益。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]卡西尔曾是效命于达格达的天使。巨龙时代，他致力于保护那些躲避周遭交战诸神威能的人类。正是他的谏言促使达格达创立并签署了契约，但卡西尔觉得契约做得还不够。他希望众神彻底退场，让人类构建自己的世界。当契约允许众神借人类之手交战时，卡西尔弃达格达而去，开始了自己的征程——引领人类远离一场与他们几乎无关的战争。此举让他在众神与效命于神的人类中鲜有盟友。少数勇敢的灵魂为卡西尔的信条所吸引，尽管他拒绝向他们提供任何神圣的恩赐、乃至直接的领导。他的追随者必须恪守他的理念，自己领导自己。历经诸时代，格利高里人的城市为那些想要主宰自己人生的人提供了安全的港湾。魔法时代的战争与寒冰时代的匮乏，如同对待其他每一片土地一样在他们身上留下了创伤，但他们求助的不是天界，而是自己。[PARAGRAPH:1]在重生时代，卡西尔依然屹立，向他人提供理念与指引，却仅止于此，仍有少数勇者为他的理念所吸引。在那些于他的领地寻求庇护者中，有天母审判官一族，他们教导说：在埃瑞布斯行事的诸神，无一值得崇拜，唯有那位创造了他们的更高之神才值得。卡西尔当然认同前半句，至于后半句，他则不置可否。

english: [TAB]The Hippus are the undisputed king of mounted units, gaining extra movement and withdrawal chance to all mounted units and starting with horses. Their mercenaries are swifter than those of other nations as well.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The Hippus were always justly proud of their animal husbandry. Their lands, even in the Age of Magic, had fertile hills that teemed with sheep and wide plains with vast herds of horses that they tamed very shortly after the Compact, passing this trade down in their tribes since time immemorial. However in Patria magic surpassed the use of horses for most purposes. Great creatures were conjured for war, portals allowed rapid travel, and golems toiled endlessly in the fields. Then came the great upheaval of Patria, when magicians turned against each other, battling for the soul of the empire of man. Kylorin called upon the Hippus people to help him hunt down his wayward servants as the portals across Erebus were closed, and when Demons and Elementals were banished the wild Hippus raiders were still there to charge down enemy warrior mages. These exploits brought great renown to a people formerly ignored in the great empire, even as the empire crumbled. This new-found pride crippled the Hippus, breeding a fierce martial competitiveness. Their clans, even while nominally aligned, would refuse each other's help and even raid each other. They were able to hold back the advances of the frostling hordes of the Age of Ice, though many Hippus communities were wiped out by a frost golem assault rather than seek the aid of their cohorts. [PARAGRAPH:1] As the other great nations emerged into the Age of Rebirth, the Hippus turned to raid them, as well as each other, until this proud people looked to be eclipsed by peoples more united and disciplined. Rhoanna, who inherited leadership of a small Hippus tribe, made it her mission to unite her people without losing their culture. She formed the Hippus mercenary companies, and made their martial prowess and competitiveness serve them rather then consume them. Tasunke was the most famous raider amongst the Hippus; it was expected that he would challenge her for leadership, but he embraced her idea, seeing foreign gold as a better measure of a tribe's prowess than slain kinsmen.
chinese: [TAB]希普斯人是骑乘单位无可争议的王者，所有骑乘单位都获得额外移动力与撤退几率，且一开局便拥有马匹。他们的雇佣兵也比他国的更为迅捷。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]希普斯人向来理直气壮地以其畜牧技艺为荣。他们的土地即便在魔法时代，也有遍布绵羊的肥沃丘陵，以及有着大群马匹的辽阔平原——契约缔结后不久他们便驯服了这些马，自远古以来这门营生便在部族中代代相传。然而在帕特里亚，魔法在多数用途上取代了马匹。宏大的生物被召唤来作战，传送门允许快速移动，魔像在田间不知疲倦地劳作。随后便是帕特里亚的大动荡，魔法师们反目成仇，为人类帝国的灵魂而战。凯洛林召唤希普斯人助他追捕那些叛离的仆从，其时埃瑞布斯各处的传送门被一一关闭；而当恶魔与元素被放逐时，狂野的希普斯劫掠者仍在那里，冲垮敌方的战法师。这些功绩为一个昔日在大帝国中被忽视的民族赢得了巨大的声望，即便那帝国正在崩塌。这份新得的荣耀却也拖垮了希普斯人，滋生出一种凶悍的尚武竞争之心。他们的氏族即便名义上结盟，也会拒绝彼此相助，甚至相互劫掠。他们得以抵挡寒冰时代冰霜怪大军的进攻，尽管许多希普斯社群宁可被冰霜魔像的攻势抹去，也不愿寻求同族的援助。[PARAGRAPH:1] 当其他大国步入重生时代，希普斯人转而劫掠他们，也劫掠彼此，直到这个骄傲的民族眼看要被更团结、更有纪律的民族所掩盖。继承了一个希普斯小部族领导权的罗安娜，把统一族人、又不失其文化，当作了自己的使命。她组建了希普斯雇佣兵团，让族人的尚武与好胜为其所用，而非将其吞噬。塔松克是希普斯人中最负盛名的劫掠者；人们本以为他会挑战她的领导权，但他接纳了她的理念，认为异国的黄金比被杀的族人更能衡量一个部族的勇武。

english: Have access to a series of rituals that leads to the creation of the [LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]Auric Ascended[\\LINK] unit.
chinese: 能使用一系列仪式，最终创造出 [LINK=UNIT_AURIC_ASCENDED]冬神化身[\\LINK] 单位。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The lost men of Letum Frigus. They banded together behind Auric Ulvin for a chance to recover their lost dominance. It is said that when the Illians awake, the world sleeps; and when the world sleeps, the Illians awake.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]莱图姆·弗里古斯的失落之民。他们聚集在奥里克·尤尔文麾下，只为一个重夺失落霸权的机会。据说，伊利安人醒时，世界沉睡；世界沉睡时，伊利安人苏醒。

english: Gain [LINK=UNIT_MANES]Manes[\\LINK] when Evil units die.[NEWLINE]  [ICON_BULLET]Cities start with free buildings and the Ashen Veil religion[NEWLINE]  [ICON_BULLET]Cities spread Hell terrain
chinese: 当邪恶单位死亡时获得 [LINK=UNIT_MANES]恶灵[\\LINK]。[NEWLINE]  [ICON_BULLET]城市开局即附带免费建筑与灰烬帷幕宗教[NEWLINE]  [ICON_BULLET]城市会扩散地狱地形

english: [TAB]The Infernals enter into any game where the Infernal Pact technology is researched. They start with powerful units, including their hero, Hyborem.[NEWLINE][TAB]The Infernals get a free [LINK=BUILDING_ELDER_COUNCIL]Elder Council[\\LINK], [LINK=BUILDING_TRAINING_YARD]Training Yard[\\LINK], [LINK=BUILDING_OBSIDIAN_GATE]Obsidian Gate[\\LINK], [LINK=BUILDING_FORGE]Forge[\\LINK], [LINK=BUILDING_MAGE_GUILD]Mage Guild[\\LINK] and [LINK=BUILDING_DEMONIC_CITIZENS]Demonic Citizens[\\LINK] in each of their cities. Their cities also start with the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]Ashen Veil[\\LINK] religion and the [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]Order[\\LINK] religion is automatically removed from cities they capture.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]What could be worse than hell? The domain of a fallen god, whispers of it are found in every religion.[PARAGRAPH:1]"The wicked shall face their eternal punishment in hell," says the Confessor.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Its fires burn hotter than any forge, and the foolish burn away like fool's gold," the Stonewarden warns.[PARAGRAPH:1]"The hottest days of summer do not compare," intones the Priests of Leaves, "and there is no rebirth for those defilers exiled there."[PARAGRAPH:1]The Cultists babble, "In the fire or in the void, your masters cannot speak to you, nor you to them; shun the realm of the fallen sun, and falter not in your labors for your lords, or you shall be so banished!"[PARAGRAPH:1]And in the rituals of the Ashen Veil lie these words: "From the fires of the pit, come our secrets, but we acknowledge we are supplicants, and offer the price you seek. We come to bargain, not command, oh Lords of the darkness and eternal fires. For this presumption, take not our souls, take those of our foes."[PARAGRAPH:1]But the truth is much worse. Hell is an attack on every aspect of the souls that dwell within it. An excruciating forge built to transform the weak and broken into physical manifestations of Agares's hate. In life a man may consider an act unthinkable, but through the slow manipulations of hell that act will become acceptable and then enjoyable. Many spend eternity in this slow grind, hating those above them and crushing those below them.[PARAGRAPH:1]Hyborem was not so easily satisfied, he thirsted for new challenges. With the covert assistance of Agares, the walls of creation were weakened imperceptibly by rituals learned by the Ashen Veil. Hell, always existing alongside the infinite plane where mortals dwelt, was given brief, tortured access. Hyborem took his servants and set out at once.[PARAGRAPH:1]They are forced to carve a city from the dirt with their own claws when this reality refuses to submit to their will. But that will is strengthened by Hyborem's demonic desires, and his underlings' abject fear of him. Hot tempered and impatient, he is nonetheless cunning and willing to watch the kingdoms of men, even to learn from them how to operate in this realm, until his goals are fulfilled and he can bring as many mortals into hell to torment for eternity.
chinese: [TAB]只要研究出地狱契约科技，地狱军团便会进入任何一局游戏。他们起始便拥有强大的单位，包括其英雄海勃雷姆。[NEWLINE][TAB]地狱军团在其每一座城市中都免费获得一座 [LINK=BUILDING_ELDER_COUNCIL]长老议会[\\LINK]、[LINK=BUILDING_TRAINING_YARD]训练场[\\LINK]、[LINK=BUILDING_OBSIDIAN_GATE]黑曜石之门[\\LINK]、[LINK=BUILDING_FORGE]锻炉[\\LINK]、[LINK=BUILDING_MAGE_GUILD]法师公会[\\LINK] 及 [LINK=BUILDING_DEMONIC_CITIZENS]恶魔居民[\\LINK]。他们的城市还起始便带有 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]灰烬帷幕[\\LINK] 宗教，而 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]秩序[\\LINK] 宗教则会从他们所占领的城市中自动移除。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]还有什么比地狱更糟？一位堕落之神的领域，每一种宗教中都能寻见对它的低语。[PARAGRAPH:1]“恶徒将在地狱面对他们永恒的惩罚，”忏悔祭司如是说。[PARAGRAPH:1]“它的火焰比任何锻炉都灼热，愚人如愚人金般被烧尽，”守护祭司警告道。[PARAGRAPH:1]“盛夏最炎热的日子也无从相比，”绿树祭司吟诵道，“而那些被流放至此的亵渎者，绝无重生之望。”[PARAGRAPH:1]狂热祭司含糊地念叨：“在火焰中，或在虚空里，你的主人无法向你言语，你亦无法向他们言语；避开那陨落太阳的领域，为你的主上劳作时切莫懈怠，否则你也将被如此放逐！”[PARAGRAPH:1]而在灰烬帷幕的仪式中，有这样一段话：“自深坑之火中，我们的秘密涌出，但我们承认自己是恳求者，愿献上你所索求的代价。我们前来议价，而非发号施令，噢，黑暗与永恒之火的主宰啊。念此僭越，请勿取我们的灵魂，而取我们仇敌的灵魂。”[PARAGRAPH:1]但真相要糟糕得多。地狱是对居于其中的灵魂的每一个层面的攻击。那是一座令人痛不欲生的锻炉，专为把软弱与破碎者转化为阿加雷斯之恨的实体显现而建。人在世时或许会认为某种行径不可思议，但经由地狱缓慢的操纵，那行径将先变得可以接受，继而变得令人愉悦。许多人在这缓慢的碾磨中度过永恒，憎恨着自己之上者，碾压着自己之下者。[PARAGRAPH:1]海勃雷姆却不那么容易满足，他渴求新的挑战。在阿加雷斯暗中相助下，创世的壁垒经由灰烬帷幕习得的仪式，被不知不觉地削弱。地狱——始终与凡人所居的无限位面并存——被给予了短暂而痛苦的通道。海勃雷姆当即带上他的仆从出发了。[PARAGRAPH:1]当这个现实拒绝屈从于他们的意志时，他们只得用自己的爪子从泥土中刨出一座城市。但那意志因海勃雷姆的恶魔欲望、以及其爪牙对他的极度恐惧而愈发强韧。他性情暴烈、缺乏耐心，却也狡黠，且愿意观察人类的王国——甚至从中学习如何在这片领域行事——直到他的目标达成，能把尽可能多的凡人带入地狱，永世折磨。

english: [TAB]Dwarven siege is unmatched, and their production can be extraordinary. They cannot train arcane units, however, and require a large amount of gold per city to reach their full potential.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]During the Age of Magic the dwarves were not the united nation that they would become in the Age of Winter. Scattered tribes of mountain peoples, they were skilled craftsmen and engineers but had little interest in the areas beyond their lands. Amiable and welcoming, they made perfect targets for the con-men and tricksters of other kingdoms. The greatest works of their smiths and their shapers were traded for trinkets and baubles, or worse, mere illusions that vanished when their creators were gone. The dwarves couldn't win redress from the local lords through strength of arms or force of argument. They had no great armies, and the neighboring rulers pointed out that the dwarves had, after all, agreed to the bargains.[PARAGRAPH:1]This abuse bred distrust of both foreigners and all forms of illusion and magic. It also pushed them underground. Their formerly welcoming cities built along mountain passes were slowly abandoned for safer under-hill communities. The tribes grew closer, and gradually out of many a single unified civilization was formed, the Khazad. The dwarves began to ask themselves why they ever even bothered with outsiders.[PARAGRAPH:1]Towards the end of the Age of Magic, few dwarves were seen by other races, and it was later said that deep in their under-hill holds, they didn't notice the Age of Winter for three generations. Though this is almost certainly an exaggeration, while the kingdoms of men and elves withered under Mulcarn's onslaught the dwarves grew slowly but steadily. Then one day their gatherers returned from the surface with reports of lush vegetation returning, and snow melting.[PARAGRAPH:1]Kandros Fir led one group of Khazad out of their cavernous homes, to form cities and trade with the new kingdoms of men and of elves. He does not revere tradition as most dwarves do; rather, he pioneered arts new to his people: negotiation, appraisal, marketing. He pursues trading partners with zeal, by force if necessary, always determined to advance the Khazad's fortunes. Remembering the insults they were subjected to in generations past the Khazad are determined that they be secure as they venture out into the world. Not just the security of high walls and stout hammers, but of brimming coffers and judicious merchants.[PARAGRAPH:1]While his goals draw him outward, what is unknown outside of a few dwarven circles is that internecine conflict helped push him and his followers to the surface. Both he and Arturus Thorne want the best for their people, but they are committed to different visions of achieving it. The limits of underground expansion were reached in ages past, and so both leaders must use the wider world to prove their vision for the Khazad in the age of rebirth.
chinese: [TAB]矮人的攻城能力无可匹敌，其生产力也可能非同凡响。然而，他们无法训练奥术单位，且每座城市都需要大量黄金才能发挥全部潜力。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]魔法时代的矮人，还不是他们日后在寒冬时代将成为的那个统一国度。作为四散的山地部族，他们是技艺精湛的工匠与工程师，却对自家土地之外的天地兴趣寥寥。他们和蔼可亲、热情好客，成了他国骗子与奸商的完美目标。他们巧匠与塑造师的最伟大作品，被拿去换了些小饰物与摆件，或者更糟——不过是些造物者一走便消散的幻象。矮人无从凭武力或论辩之力从当地领主那里讨回公道。他们没有强大的军队，而邻邦的统治者会指出：毕竟，是矮人自己同意了那些交易。[PARAGRAPH:1]这种欺凌滋生了他们对外邦人、以及对一切形式的幻象与魔法的不信任。它也把他们逼入了地下。他们昔日沿山口而建、热情好客的城市，渐渐被弃，换作更安全的丘陵之下的社群。部族越走越近，渐渐由众多部族融成了一个统一的文明——卡扎德。矮人开始扪心自问，自己当初究竟何苦要与外人打交道。[PARAGRAPH:1]魔法时代将尽时，其他种族已鲜少见到矮人，后世甚至有传言说，在他们深藏丘陵之下的居所里，他们竟有三代人没有察觉寒冬时代的到来。尽管这几乎肯定是夸张之辞，但当人类与精灵的王国在穆卡恩的猛攻下凋零时，矮人却在缓慢而稳定地壮大。直到有一天，他们的采集者从地表归来，报告说葱郁的植被正在回归，冰雪正在消融。[PARAGRAPH:1]坎德罗斯·法尔率领一群卡扎德人走出他们洞穴般的居所，建立城市，与人类和精灵的新兴王国通商。他不像多数矮人那样崇奉传统；相反，他开创了对其族人而言全新的技艺：谈判、估价、营销。他热忱地追逐贸易伙伴，必要时不惜动武，始终决意增进卡扎德人的财富。铭记着前几代所遭受的欺辱，卡扎德人决意在踏入这个世界时确保自身的安全——不仅是高墙与坚锤的安全，更是满溢的金库与精明的商人所带来的安全。[PARAGRAPH:1]尽管他的目标引他向外，但鲜为外界所知的是（除了少数矮人圈子），内部的纷争也助推了他和他的追随者走向地表。他和阿特鲁斯·索内都想为族人谋求最好的前程，却各自执著于实现它的不同愿景。地下扩张的极限早在几个时代前便已触及，因此两位领袖都必须借助更广阔的世界，来证明各自对重生时代卡扎德人的构想。

english: [TAB]The Kuriotates are limited in the number of cities that they can acquire, but those cities will have greater production due to a wider workable area. The rest of their cities beyond this limit are [LINK=CONCEPT_SETTLEMENTS]Settlements[\\LINK].[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The nucleus of the Kuriotates was formed in the harrowing years between the end of the Age of Ice and the dawn of the Age of Rebirth. Squabbling tribes, clans, warlords and embryonic city-states were gathered into a small nation led by the boy-king Cardith Lorda. It is in this background that we find the secret behind the Kuriotates' rather odd societal structure. All these diverse elements gathered together in a sheltered and bountiful land, and started to forge a state that could survive in a dangerous world. However, the mutual distrust between all the clans, families and dynasties Cardith Lorda brought together means that they will not suffer another to grow more powerful than they are. In effect, the lower levels of government in the core regions are marked by a form of democracy, watched over by a royal administration with complete control.[PARAGRAPH:1]Thus, all expansion is conducted by the King, and by him alone, and all territory is royal territory. The army swears allegiance to the king alone, and all administrative functions flow from the state rather than a master-servant system. There is no feudal system among the Kuriotates. The powerful live in the cities, and compete for positions there. In the outlying areas, the powerful are only powerful by royal decree, and Cardith Lorda's careful machinations ensures that it stays that way. Thus arose the system of settlements.[PARAGRAPH:1]The Kuriotates are a confederation of peoples and races, marked by a very powerful core region, vast areas more loosely connected to the core cities, and full freedom of asylum, even citizenship, for those who wish to move from other nations or the wilderness of uncivilized territory. The settlements, controlled solely by the central administration (i.e., Cardith Lorda's government) act as administrative centers, tying vast areas, often with their own highly advanced semi-autonomous indigenous populations, into the Kuriotate confederacy. The settlements provide facilities for transit, trade, administration and diplomacy in the affiliated regions, but never develop a very large population of pure Kuriotates. They are mostly populated by bureaucrats, merchants, a handful of soldiers and their families and the most promising born here quickly relocate to the central cities. A system of trade and friendship with their centre on the small Kuriotate settlements keeps the hodge-podge of allies, protectorates, semi-autonomies and client states happy and ensures that much-needed resources continue to flow to the core lands.[PARAGRAPH:1]The vast areas with sparse human population that get locked within the Kuriotates' disproportionately large sphere of influence and cultural domination mean that they get in contact with many of the rarer species of Erebus. For many civilizations, that might prove problematic, even act as a source of conflict and destruction. For the Kuriotates, it is a boon, and a source of their strength.[PARAGRAPH:1]For the Kuriotates don't much care who you are as long as you have something meaningful to offer to the nation as a whole. The Kuriotates' particularly positive relationship to the non-human species of Erebus dates back to the very beginnings of the confederation, when a small group of centaurs aided Cardith Lorda in his rise to power. Other creatures, attracted by the special power they detect in the boy king, have since flocked to the Kuriotate banner, escaping marginalization or even persecution in other parts of the world. The centaurs, having risen to be a force to be reckoned with in Kuriotate political life, smooth their transition and integration into the society, putting their special skills to good use in the areas at which they excel, through innate ability or cultural conditioning.[PARAGRAPH:1]The culture of the Kuriotates is such that the demi-humans are treated as, and indeed regarded as being, equal to the human majority, and judged by merit and benefit to the nation alone, although the fundamental differences between the races mean that some measure of distinction is necessary in order to allow the Kuriotate nation to run smoothly. However, again this may be a secret benefit.[PARAGRAPH:1]This specialization and segregation has given rise to something akin to a caste system, another reason the Kuriotates have such a stable central government. While the humans are the jack of all trades, each of the races has found its own niche. The centaurs, the warrior caste, hold many high positions in the army, the lamia wield great magical power, and command respect among the magi, and so on. Since all these subcultures owe allegiance to the king alone, they act, in their specialized roles, as an effective bulwark against the ambitions of human noblemen.[PARAGRAPH:1]Those few dissidents who let their resentment at being bypassed be channeled into irrational hatred of demi-humans are held in check by strong personal trust in Cardith Lorda and an emphasis on the state religion, not to mention state superstition and traditions. Few Kuriotates dare cross or even question the will of the state, the will of the people of the confederation, and most importantly, the will of the divine Boy-King.[PARAGRAPH:1]The Kuriotates hold loose sway over a massive sprawl of an empire, but the borders are porous, and when war threatens, they will often act as a turtle, retreating into the hard shell of their core lands until they can muster the forces to take back that which was lost. Thus, the Kuriotates through their openness to others, strong central authority and large but loose sphere of influence have a flexibility many of their opponents lack. Truly, they are one of the centers of enlightenment in the dark of Erebus.
chinese: [TAB]库里奥塔特人所能拥有的城市数量有限，但那些城市因可作业范围更广而拥有更高的生产力。超出此上限的其余城市均为 [LINK=CONCEPT_SETTLEMENTS]定居点[\\LINK]。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]库里奥塔特的雏形，形成于寒冰时代终结与重生时代破晓之间那段惨痛的岁月。争吵不休的部族、氏族、军阀与初具雏形的城邦，被聚拢成一个由少年王卡迪斯·罗达统领的小国。正是在这一背景中，我们找到了库里奥塔特那颇为奇特的社会结构背后的秘密。所有这些形形色色的元素汇聚在一片庇护而丰饶的土地上，开始锻造一个能在危险世界中存续的国家。然而，卡迪斯·罗达聚拢的所有氏族、家族与王朝之间的相互猜忌，意味着他们绝不容许另一方变得比自己更强大。实际上，核心地区的下层政府呈现出一种民主的形态，由一个握有完全控制权的王室行政机构监管。[PARAGRAPH:1]因此，一切扩张皆由国王一人主导，一切领土皆为王室领土。军队只效忠于国王，一切行政职能皆出自国家，而非一套主仆体系。库里奥塔特人中没有封建制度。权贵居于城市，在那里争夺职位。在边远地区，权贵之所以有权，全凭王室敕令，而卡迪斯·罗达的精心运作确保了这一格局的延续。定居点体系便由此而生。[PARAGRAPH:1]库里奥塔特是一个由诸多民族与种族组成的邦联，其特征是有一个极其强大的核心地区、大片与核心城市更为松散相连的区域，以及对那些愿意从他国或未开化蛮荒之地迁来者提供的充分庇护自由乃至公民权。定居点仅由中央行政机构（即卡迪斯·罗达的政府）掌控，作为行政中心，把大片区域——往往有着各自高度发达的半自治原住民——维系进库里奥塔特邦联。定居点为所属地区提供交通、贸易、行政与外交的设施，但从不发展出很大规模的纯库里奥塔特人口。它们大多由官僚、商人、少量士兵及其家眷居住，而在此出生的最有前途者，很快便迁往中心城市。一套以小小的库里奥塔特定居点为中心的贸易与友谊体系，让这一堆杂七杂八的盟友、保护地、半自治体与附庸国皆大欢喜，并确保急需的资源持续流向核心之地。[PARAGRAPH:1]那些落入库里奥塔特那不成比例地庞大的影响范围与文化统治之下、人烟稀少的广袤地区，意味着他们会接触到埃瑞布斯许多较为罕见的物种。对许多文明而言，这或许会成为问题，甚至成为冲突与毁灭的根源。而对库里奥塔特人而言，这是一份恩赐，也是他们力量的源泉。[PARAGRAPH:1]因为库里奥塔特人并不太在意你是谁，只要你能为整个国家贡献有意义的东西。库里奥塔特人与埃瑞布斯非人类物种之间尤为正面的关系，可追溯至邦联的最初——当时一小群半人马助卡迪斯·罗达崛起掌权。其他生物为他们在少年王身上察觉到的特殊力量所吸引，此后纷纷投奔库里奥塔特的旗帜，逃离在世界其他地方所遭受的边缘化乃至迫害。半人马已崛起为库里奥塔特政治生活中一股不容小觑的力量，他们帮助其他物种顺利过渡、融入社会，凭借与生俱来的能力或文化熏陶，在自己擅长的领域善用其特殊技艺。[PARAGRAPH:1]库里奥塔特的文化使得半人类被当作、并确实被视为与人类多数群体平等，仅凭功绩与对国家的贡献受评判——尽管种族间的根本差异意味着，为使库里奥塔特这个国家顺畅运转，某种程度的区分是必要的。然而，这或许又是一种暗藏的裨益。[PARAGRAPH:1]这种专精与隔离催生出某种类似种姓制度的东西，这也是库里奥塔特中央政府如此稳固的又一缘由。人类是万金油，而每个种族都找到了自己的一席之地。半人马是战士种姓，在军中占据许多要职；拉弥亚掌握着强大的魔力，在术士中备受敬重，如此种种。由于所有这些亚文化都只效忠于国王，他们在各自专精的角色中，充当着抵御人类贵族野心的有效壁垒。[PARAGRAPH:1]那少数因被越过而心生怨怼、任其化作对半人类非理性仇恨的异见者，则被对卡迪斯·罗达强烈的个人信任、以及对国教的强调所制约——更不必说国家的迷信与传统。鲜有库里奥塔特人胆敢违逆、乃至质疑国家的意志、邦联人民的意志，而最重要的是，那位神圣少年王的意志。[PARAGRAPH:1]库里奥塔特人对一个庞大而蔓延的帝国维持着松散的统治，但边界是可渗透的，一旦战争来临，他们往往会像乌龟一样退回核心之地坚硬的壳中，直到能集结起夺回失地的力量。因此，库里奥塔特人凭借对他者的开放、强有力的中央权威，以及庞大而松散的影响范围，拥有许多对手所不具备的灵活性。诚然，他们是埃瑞布斯黑暗中的启明中心之一。

english: [TAB]The Lanun gain more food from every water tile, and their ships move farther. Once on land they must rely on the same units as everyone else, but the oceans hold no obstacle to them.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]As the ferocious monsters were removed from the seas with the signing of the Compact, man expanded into them, and these first explorers were the ancestors of the Lanun. There were still beasts such as leviathans and giant turtles to contend with, but these were not insurmountable obstacles to the brave men on those early, leaky galleys and later triremes. Danalin offered these men his guidance, and they formed friendships with the otherwise elusive Aifons, those men most close to the sea god who lived in underwater cities. Island communities of Lanun developed, each with their own customs, but sharing most of the values of the mainland coastal Lanun cities, a love of freedom and adventure, guile, and a flexible sense of honor. When Kylorin solidified his rule of Patria and began to incorporate neighboring kingdoms into his empire, by force if needed, the distant Lanun freely pledged. They only bothered to enforce those laws they agreed with, however, and allowed fugitives to flee aboard ship and seek their fortunes on the waves. Occasionally a Lanun city would be punished for this, though their trade routes made them too valuable to make an example of. Patria soon collapsed, as wars broke out between the wicked mages and those seeking redemption for the world of men. The Lanun happily aided both sides, taking fleeing mages across the waves and then selling ships to the Patrian fire priests seeking them down. Then their world was shaken by the gods, as Bhall's rain of fire and Mulcarn's conquest brought civilizations crashing down. The seas were made more hazardous by huge icebergs that could tear a ship to pieces before being seen, and some Lanun communities were in fact completely isolated by encroaching ice. Further imperiling Lanun seafarers during this time, their priests lost all contact with Danalin, and their rituals began to behave in unexpected ways. Those Lanun crews who were still willing to brave the seas found great fame and wealth trading between distant tribes, though this often made them a target of the blizzards and many crews were never heard from again, including the ship captained by Malus which carried an artifact from Cassiel into Amurite lands.[PARAGRAPH:1] Eventually the ice receded, and the Lanun were reunited. They found they barely knew their kin, as crew in different locations had evolved quite different outlooks and values. This wasn't a problem for the Lanun, though, for each captain rules his own ship in the manner he sees fit. The sea captains are where the real power in Lanun territory lies, for captains outrank provincial governors and can conscript any person for any reason. The only authority a Lanun captain acknowledges over him is another captain to whom he has given his word, though as always the word of a Lanun is somewhat fleeting. The real problem is that the ocean is no longer quite as welcoming as it once was, and whereas they could before seek the aid the God of Water, those petitions are unheeded now, or worse, answered by strange creatures that emerge from the depths. [PARAGRAPH:1]Some Lanun captains retain the carefree spirit of their people despite this new challenge, while others, like Hannah the Irin, embrace the darker nature the seas have taken. Falamar sees himself as a dashing rogue. He tends not to kill the victims of his raids (claiming that would keep them from bringing him more loot), and he is an excellent swordsman and charming leader. Hannah is everything he isn't. She is the storm personified, temperamental and powerful. She has had entire cities razed for a perceived insult, and rules not by charm, but by fear. Which view will prove more effective in the new age is yet to be seen, but as always there is room in the Lanun for each captain to choose his or her own path.
chinese: [TAB]拉努恩人从每一块水域地块获得更多食物，其舰船也航行得更远。一旦登上陆地，他们便须与其他所有人依赖同样的单位，但海洋对他们而言毫无阻碍。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]随着凶猛的怪物在契约缔结后从海中被移除，人类向海洋拓展，而这些最早的探险者便是拉努恩人的先祖。仍有诸如深海巨兽与巨龟之类的野兽需要应付，但对那些乘着早期漏水的桨帆船、后来的三列桨战船的勇者而言，这些并非不可逾越的障碍。达纳林向这些人提供指引，他们与原本难觅踪影的艾冯斯结下友谊——那些最亲近海神、居于水下城市之人。拉努恩的岛屿社群逐渐发展起来，各有各的习俗，却共享大陆沿海拉努恩城市的大部分价值观：热爱自由与冒险、诡诈，以及一种灵活变通的荣誉感。当凯洛林巩固了对帕特里亚的统治，并开始把邻近王国——必要时以武力——纳入其帝国时，遥远的拉努恩人自愿归附。然而，他们只肯执行那些自己认可的律法，还允许逃亡者登船遁走，去浪涛之上碰运气。偶尔会有一座拉努恩城市因此受罚，不过他们的贸易路线使其太过宝贵，以致无法拿来杀鸡儆猴。帕特里亚很快便崩塌了，邪恶的法师与那些为人类世界寻求救赎者之间爆发了战争。拉努恩人乐得两边相助，既载着逃亡的法师渡过浪涛，又把船卖给追杀他们的帕特里亚火焰祭司。随后，他们的世界为众神所撼动，巴尔的火雨与穆卡恩的征服令文明轰然崩塌。海洋因巨大的冰山而愈发凶险——那些冰山能在被发现之前便将一艘船撕成碎片——一些拉努恩社群实际上被步步逼近的坚冰彻底孤立。这段时期更令拉努恩航海者岌岌可危的是，他们的祭司与达纳林完全失去了联系，他们的仪式开始以意想不到的方式运作。那些仍愿冒险出海的拉努恩船员，在遥远部族间的贸易中赢得了巨大的名声与财富，尽管这往往令他们成为暴风雪的目标，许多船员就此杳无音讯——包括马卢斯所指挥、载着一件来自卡西尔的神器驶入阿姆莱特领地的那艘船。[PARAGRAPH:1] 坚冰终于消退，拉努恩人重聚。他们发现自己几乎认不出自己的族人，因为不同地方的船员已演化出迥异的观念与价值。不过这对拉努恩人不成问题，因为每位船长都以自己认为合适的方式统治自己的船。海船船长才是拉努恩领地真正权力之所在，因为船长的地位高于省督，并能以任何理由征召任何人。拉努恩船长唯一承认凌驾于己之上的权威，是另一位他曾向其许下诺言的船长——尽管一如既往，拉努恩人的诺言多少有些靠不住。真正的问题在于，海洋不再如往昔那般友善，从前他们能向水神求助，如今那些祈求或无人理会，或者更糟——回应他们的，是从深渊中浮现的奇异生物。[PARAGRAPH:1]一些拉努恩船长虽面对这一新挑战，仍保有其族人无忧无虑的天性，另一些人——如艾尔琳的汉娜——则拥抱了海洋所染上的更为黑暗的本性。法拉玛自视为一名潇洒的浪荡子。他往往不杀劫掠的受害者（声称杀了他们就没人再给他送来更多战利品），他是位出色的剑客，也是个魅力十足的领袖。汉娜则与他截然相反。她是暴风雨的化身，喜怒无常而力量强大。她曾因一次臆想的冒犯而夷平整座城市，其统治靠的不是魅力，而是恐惧。哪种作风将在新时代中更为有效，尚待分晓；但一如既往，拉努恩人中总有余地，容每位船长选择自己的道路。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The elven god was killed and the elves were nearly wiped out as a result during the Age of Ice. With his resurrection (or, more importantly, the promotion of Cernunnos to be the new god of nature) they are coming back from the few hidden groves they still control.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]精灵之神在寒冰时代被杀，精灵也因此几近灭绝。随着他的复活（或者更重要的是，科尔努诺斯被擢升为新的自然之神），他们正从仍掌控着的少数隐秘林地中卷土重来。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Dwarves do not always live in caves. The Empire of Kradh-Ke-zun, the Open-Skiers, suffered terrible losses during the Age of Ice precisely because they, as opposed to their cousins the Khazad, had adapted to a life on the surface and forgotten the secrets of making their lives in the subterranean world. Fantastic craftsmen, cunning artificers, and proficient enchanters, the Kradh-Ke-zun were creators of some of the greatest artifacts of the Age of Magic, not least of which were the golems: golems for war, golems for transport, golems for farming, for mining and for industry. Life, for the Open-Skiers with their endless supply of infallibly obedient servants, was good, and the people thrived.[PARAGRAPH:1]The new reality of the Age of Ice was harsh on the Open-Skiers. When the glaciers rolled forth, strangling life, isolating populations, and crushing cities beneath tons of grinding blue ice, the Luchuirp watched helplessly as the cunning devices they had entrusted so much of their survival to succumbed to the long winter.[PARAGRAPH:1]Three-foot-tall city dwellers are not adapted to the rigorous, marginal, nomadic existence of Ice Age hunters, and few survived for long. Of the once mighty empire of great cities, thriving farmlands and millions of contented citizens, only one particularly hardy clan survived: the Luchuirp. Though weakened by the dominance of Mulcarn, Kilmorph still managed to hold a warding hand over this little tribe of surface-dwelling dwarves. She came to the leader, the now-legendary Graoin the Delver, and taught him the things his people had forgotten: how to dig, how to build homes under the mountain. Combining this with what little of their incredible artistry and golem mastery they could still make use of, they fashioned themselves a society of sorts in the caves beneath the Ice, and they waited, knowing that one day, the clan of Luchuirp, heirs of the Open-Skiers, would once again walk under the sun.[PARAGRAPH:1]Beeri Bawl is a true heir to Graoin the Delver, not only in blood, but in spirit. He is a survivalist by nature, organized and effective, but he has never forgotten his roots and his ancestry. His highest goal is to reclaim a spot on the surface, but that does not mean he intends to make the mistake of his forefathers and neglect the lower reaches of the world. His approach is a symbiosis of the refined craftsmanship of the old Empire and the hardy jury-rigging the Luchuirp taught themselves during the Age of Ice.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]矮人并不总是居于洞穴之中。克拉德-科-祖恩帝国——即“露天行者”——在寒冰时代蒙受了惨重的损失，恰恰是因为他们与堂兄弟卡扎德人不同，早已适应了地表的生活，忘却了在地下世界营生的秘诀。作为技艺超群的工匠、狡黠的巧匠与娴熟的附魔师，克拉德-科-祖恩人创造了魔法时代最伟大的一些神器，其中尤以魔像为最：作战的魔像、运输的魔像、耕作、采矿与劳作的魔像。对于拥有源源不断、绝对服从的仆从的露天行者而言，生活是美好的，其民昌盛。[PARAGRAPH:1]寒冰时代的新现实对露天行者是严酷的。当冰川滚滚而来，扼杀生机、隔绝人群、把城市碾碎于千万吨磨蚀的蓝冰之下时，鲁崔尔普人只能眼睁睁看着那些他们托付了太多生存希望的精巧装置，屈服于漫长的寒冬。[PARAGRAPH:1]三尺高的城市居民，无从适应寒冰时代猎人那严苛、边缘而游牧的生存方式，鲜有能长久幸存者。曾经拥有伟大城市、繁荣田园与数百万知足公民的强大帝国，最终只有一个格外坚韧的氏族幸存了下来：鲁崔尔普。尽管为穆卡恩的统治所削弱，基尔莫夫仍设法向这个地表矮人小部族伸出了守护之手。她来到那位如今已成传奇的“掘者”格劳因面前，把她的族人已然忘却之事教给他：如何挖掘，如何在山下筑屋。他们把这些与仍能运用的少许精湛技艺与魔像操控之术相结合，在冰下的洞穴中为自己勉强营造出一个像样的社会，然后等待着，深知有朝一日，露天行者的继承者鲁崔尔普氏族，将再度行走于阳光之下。[PARAGRAPH:1]巴里鲍尔是“掘者”格劳因名副其实的继承人，不仅承其血脉，更承其精神。他天性善于求生，有条不紊而卓有成效，却从未忘记自己的根与血统。他的最高目标是重夺地表的一席之地，但这并不意味着他打算重蹈先祖的覆辙、忽视世界的更深处。他的路径，是旧帝国精湛工艺与鲁崔尔普人在寒冰时代自学的坚韧应急之术的一种共生。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]The only elves the Malakim had seen were the dark Svartalfar. Yet, when a group of hunters happened across a nearly-dead elven man freezing in the wastes, they took him back to their village and agreed to tend to his injuries rather than kill him. When he awoke in their care, he explained that he was Varn Gosam, and that he had fled from his homeland. Sensing some truth in him, the Malakim believed him and allowed him to live among them.[PARAGRAPH:1]Varn built a shrine to Lugus in the small village and began spreading his newfound religion to the villagers. His revival spread quickly, and the former elven prince found himself a leader of men. Accepting that role, he set forth to lead the Malakim through the hard years to follow and into the light of Lugus.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]马拉基姆人所见过的唯一精灵，是黑暗的斯瓦塔尔法。然而，当一群猎人偶然遇到一个在荒原中冻得几近死去的精灵男子时，他们把他带回了村庄，并同意救治他的伤，而非杀了他。当他在他们的照料下醒来，他解释说自己名叫范恩·哥萨姆，是从故土逃亡而来。马拉基姆人感到他所言有几分真实，便相信了他，允许他在族中生活。[PARAGRAPH:1]范恩在这座小村庄里为卢古斯建了一座神殿，开始向村民传播他新得的信仰。他的复兴迅速扩散，这位昔日的精灵王子发现自己成了众人的领袖。他接受了这一角色，起身引领马拉基姆人度过随后的艰难岁月，走入卢古斯的光辉之中。
每当善良单位死亡时，获得 [LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]天使[\\LINK]。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Basium broke the Compact. He was an angel under Arawn, but when the Compact was signed, he refused to give up the direct battle with the demons. He and a small host of other rebel angels disobeyed their lords and kept fighting. They spend their time split between time on creation and in Hell waging their war directly. They can be found anywhere demons exist. They care little for people, they are only concerned with killing demons, and are often confused with demons because of their single-mindedness and their rough warlike appearance.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]巴希姆背弃了契约。他曾是阿劳恩麾下的天使，但契约签订时，他拒绝放弃与恶魔的直接交战。他与一小队其他叛逆的天使违抗主上，继续作战。他们将时光分作两半，一半在创世之中，一半在地狱里直接征战。凡有恶魔存在之处，皆可寻见他们。他们不太在意世人，一心只想斩杀恶魔，又常因其一根筋的执念、以及粗野好战的外貌而被误认作恶魔。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]There is no history of the Sheaim as a people before the Age of Rebirth. As the Age of Ice ended, they were a people from all civilizations gathered toward one purpose: ending creation through the fell magic of Armageddon spells. Most pursue this focus to increase their arcane knowledge, some believe they will receive an eternal reward for destroying creation, while a few just want the world to end.[PARAGRAPH:1]Tebryn was once a powerful runecaster who was cast into hell after his death. Ceridwen released him to pursue the destruction of creation. Os-Gabella was the first human to be made by the gods and the intended bride of Nemed. She was created as an immortal but rebelled against Nemed and the gods' plans for her. Now she is trapped in creation until the end of time. Both seek to escape their prisons by destroying the world.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]重生时代之前，塞安人作为一个民族并无历史可言。寒冰时代结束时，他们是一群来自各个文明、为同一个目的而聚集之人：借末日审判法术那毁灭性的魔法终结创世。多数人追求这一目标是为增进自己的奥术知识，一些人相信自己会因毁灭创世而获得永恒的奖赏，还有少数人只是想让世界终结。[PARAGRAPH:1]特布里恩曾是一位强大的符文施法者，死后被打入地狱。塞丽德雯将他释放，去追寻创世的毁灭。奥斯·加贝拉是众神所造的第一个人类，本是尼米德注定的新娘。她被造为不朽，却背叛了尼米德与众神为她安排的命运。如今她被困于创世之中，直至时间的尽头。二人都想借毁灭世界，逃出各自的牢笼。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]Shades, men who have traded portions of their soul for immortality, the Grey are detached from the events of the world. Only intervening to protect themselves or striking out to destroy undead (they see undead as aberrations despite their own use of magic to extend their life), they are happy to keep to their hidden cities out of the eyes, and the wars, of the younger races.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]幽影——那些以部分灵魂换取不朽之人——即“灰者”，超然于世间诸事之外。他们只在保全自身、或出手摧毁不死生物时才加以干预（他们视不死生物为悖逆之物，尽管他们自己也借魔法延续生命），乐于隐居于其隐秘的城市之中，避开年轻种族的视线与战争。

english: [H1]Background[\\H1][NEWLINE]During the Age of Magic, the elves were ruled by two separate courts. The Seelie court (the fairer and more spiritual) ruled during the spring and summer, and the Unseelie court (the more arcane and malevolent) ruled during the autumn and winter. When Sucellus died, the elven prayers went unanswered. Because the Unseelie court was in power when it happened, they decreed that the elven deity was gone and that Esus would be adopted in his place. Normally, the Seelie court would wait for spring and then reverse the ruling, but spring never came as the Age of Ice began. The Unseelie court saw this as a symbol of their dominance and began to punish elves that refused to stop worshipping Sucellus. This caused a bloody civil war within the elven nation during a time when their numbers were already hard-hit. The Age of Ice eventually stopped the war as bands were separated by expanses they couldn't cross. Now that the Age of Ice is over, they are free to reach out and begin their war anew.
chinese: [H1]背景[\\H1][NEWLINE]魔法时代，精灵由两个独立的宫廷统治。光明宫廷（较为公正、更重灵性）在春夏当政，黑暗宫廷（更重奥术、更为邪恶）在秋冬当政。苏塞鲁斯死去时，精灵的祈祷无人应答。因其发生时正值黑暗宫廷当政，他们便昭告：精灵的神祇已逝，当以杰斯取而代之。按常理，光明宫廷会等到春天再推翻这一裁决，但春天再未降临，寒冰时代就此开始。黑暗宫廷视此为自身统治的象征，开始惩罚那些拒不停止崇拜苏塞鲁斯的精灵。这在精灵族群本已元气大伤之时，引发了一场血腥的内战。寒冰时代最终终止了这场战争，因为各部落被无法逾越的广袤冰原所隔绝。如今寒冰时代已然结束，他们又可以伸出手去，重启他们的战争了。

english: Jeteye is an addictive drug that sedates and can cause horrible hallucinations. It is administered by squirting the liquid inside the eyelid, and can turn the entire iris and sclera of the user black. The source of the drug is a bit of a mystery, but the leading theory is that it is produced from the ink of Krakens.[PARAGRAPH:2]After Auric is banished to the Netherworl, the Nether Blade is stored in the Bay of Laurus. Os-Gabella ends up traveling to the city to attempt to find it and use it to end her immortal life. Before she does so she discovers the Jeteye dealers of the cities ports and finds some measure of escape in the delusions and opiate dreams the drug offers. Somewhere among the cities beggars the first human lives in squalor, once queen of the Sheaim, once grandmother to the Calabim, once unwilling bride to the god Nemed, her world is now little more than visions and dancing shadows. More than one man seeking to abuse or hurt the cities beggers has met his end when he assumed Os-Gabella was just another broken vagrant.
chinese: 墨眼是一种令人上瘾的毒品，可致人镇静，也可引发可怖的幻觉。它以将液体挤入眼睑内侧的方式施用，可使服用者的整个虹膜与巩膜变黑。这种毒品的来源有些神秘，但主流说法认为，它由海妖的墨汁制成。[PARAGRAPH:2]奥里克被放逐至冥界之后，冥刃被存放在劳鲁斯湾。奥斯·加贝拉最终辗转来到这座城市，试图寻得冥刃，用它了结自己不朽的生命。在此之前，她发现了城中港口的墨眼贩子，并在这种毒品所提供的幻觉与鸦片般的梦境中寻得了几分解脱。在城中的乞丐之间，这第一个人类活在污秽之中——她曾是塞安的女王，曾是卡拉比姆人的祖母，曾是神明尼米德不情愿的新娘，如今她的世界不过是幻象与舞动的暗影。不止一个企图欺凌或伤害城中乞丐之人，在自以为奥斯·加贝拉不过是又一个潦倒流浪汉时，走向了自己的末路。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Air sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FAIR_WINDS]Fair Winds[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR1]Air I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]Air Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MAELSTROM]Maelstrom[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR2]Air II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]Air Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_AIR_ELEMENTAL]Summon Air Elemental[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR3]Air III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]Air Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_TEMPEST]Tempest[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]Air Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH][PARAGRAPH]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Air Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_HIPPUS]Hippus[\\LINK] civilization and for those following [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]The Foxmen[\\LINK]. It is reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Air is the sphere of disregarding consequences and responsibilities in order to just have fun in the moment. The One intended for this sphere to balance out the sphere of Earth, which deals with being responsible. Air is one of the chaotic spheres, which can be considered chaos without malevolence. The ideology of this sphere may be represented as a group of men settings off to paint a random building red, but they get distracted, paint a bull and twelve geese red then spend the night taking care of the geese because they can't fly anymore with paint on them, and then they cook and eat 2 of the geese when they get hungry, paint each other red and wander back into the city the next morning red and covered in goose feathers. [PARAGRAPH]Tali is the God of Air. He does not have the patience for organized religion, but does favor a group of the [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_FOXMEN]wandering[\\LINK] worshipers known as [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]the Foxmen[\\LINK]. They tend to be daredevils, for whom adventure is the greatest form of worship. They have no temples, but do maintain several small shrines in remote locations such as the edges of the highest cliffs in the world. When Foxmen cross paths on their journeys, they like to share a drink up on the rooftops of the local Inns and Taverns.
chinese: [TAB]允许取用风系法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_FAIR_WINDS]顺风[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR1]风系 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]风之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MAELSTROM]大漩涡[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR2]风系 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]风之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_AIR_ELEMENTAL]召唤风元素[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AIR3]风系 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]风之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_TEMPEST]狂风暴雨[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]风之亲和[\\LINK] 以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK]）[PARAGRAPH][PARAGRAPH]你掌控的此类能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]奥术单位[\\LINK] 就越有可能被赋予 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_AIR]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]。这不仅会依你掌控的能量多寡提升该单位的强度，还能让它免费习得该领域法术更强大的版本，无需耗费任何经验升级，只要它拥有相应的引导晋升即可。[PARAGRAPH]对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_HIPPUS]希普斯[\\LINK] 文明、以及信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]狐人[\\LINK] 者而言，风之能量的有效供给更为充裕。而对信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]基尔莫夫符文[\\LINK] 者——无论作为国教还是施法者个人的信仰——则会减少。[PARAGRAPH:2]风是抛开后果与责任、只为把握当下之乐的领域。太一本意让此领域与掌管尽责的“土”之领域相互平衡。风是混沌领域之一，可被视为不带恶意的混沌。此领域的理念，或可描绘为一群人出发去随手把某座建筑漆成红色，却分了心，把一头公牛和十二只鹅漆成了红色，随后花了一整夜照料那些鹅——因为身上带着漆，它们再也飞不起来了——接着他们饿了，便煮吃了其中 2 只鹅，把彼此漆成红色，翌日清晨浑身通红、沾满鹅毛地晃回了城里。[PARAGRAPH]塔利是风之神。他没有耐心搞有组织的宗教，却眷顾一群被称为 [LINK=RELIGION_FOXMEN]狐人[\\LINK] 的 [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_FOXMEN]流浪[\\LINK] 崇拜者。他们往往是些亡命之徒，冒险于他们便是崇拜的最高形式。他们没有神庙，却在诸如世上最高悬崖之巅这般偏远之地维护着几座小神龛。当狐人在旅途中不期而遇，他们喜欢在当地客栈与酒馆的屋顶上共饮一杯。

That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions. [PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Body Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CALABIM]Calabim[\\LINK] civilization. [PARAGRAPH:2]Body is the sphere of strength.
