It has become the sphere of rage and the basest of passions. It is however not wild and uncontrolled, but cold and calculating. Aeron is the God of Murder, the patron of assassins and psychopaths.
chinese: [TAB]允许取用体系法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_HASTE]急速[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_BODY1]体系 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_BODY]体之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_REGENERATION]再生[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_BODY2]体系 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_BODY]体之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_STRENGTHEN]强化[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_BODY3]体系 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_BODY]体之亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_CREATE_CHIMERA]创造奇美拉[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_BODY]体之亲和[\\LINK] 以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK]）[PARAGRAPH][PARAGRAPH]你掌控的此类能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]奥术单位[\\LINK] 就越有可能被赋予 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_BODY]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]。这不仅会依你掌控的能量多寡提升该单位的强度，还能让它免费习得该领域法术更强大的版本，无需耗费任何经验升级，只要它拥有相应的引导晋升即可。[PARAGRAPH]对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CALABIM]卡拉比姆[\\LINK] 文明而言，体之能量的有效供给更为充裕。[PARAGRAPH:2]体是力量的领域。它本应辅助“灵”之领域，让强者保护弱者，但自艾伦陨落以来，强者更愿彰显自身的支配，欺压弱者。它已沦为狂怒与最卑劣激情的领域。然而它并非狂野失控，而是冷酷而精于算计。艾伦是谋杀之神，刺客与疯子的守护神。

english: [TAB]The more of this resource you control the more likely your arcane units are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CREATION]Creation Affinity[\\LINK]. This sphere is unique in that its affinity may be even granted to [LINK=UNIT_ADEPT]Adepts[\\LINK] with no experience rather than being reserved for those who have reached level 3 and been upgraded to Mages. It is also unique in that it does not have any promotions that may be learned with experience when a unit levels up. There are no lesser and greater versions of its spells. [PARAGRAPH]Creation affinity allows access to the Creation sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MUSE]Muse[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_PIXIE]Summon Pixie[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ABUNDANCE]Abundance[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_REJUVENATE]Rejuvenate[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH:2]The effective supply of Creation Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]Kuriotates[\\LINK] civilization or those following [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\\LINK]. It is reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Creation is the sphere of new beginnings, births, and inspiration. It is about original ideas and the emergence of unexpected order out of creative chaos. The One intended for Creation to be the compliment of Hope. Hope longs for a particular outcome, drives us to work towards it, and may lead to despair if its aim seems unattainable. Creation prefers to remain open to unexpected possibilities, which often turns out better than fixating on what we thought we wanted. [PARAGRAPH]Amathaon presides over this sphere. He is a gentle soul who loves little children and hates conflict. He wanted nothing to do with the Godswar, but knew that the forces of his sphere must marshal in order to stop Agares from destroying Erebus out of spite. Rather than personally fight, he invented the weapon of mass destruction that came to define the age: The Dragon. Other gods soon copied him and created many such beasts to serve them, but all paled in comparison to [LINK=UNIT_EURABATRES]Eurabatres the Golden Dragon[\\LINK]. The first true dragon was the greatest being ever created since The One made the gods themselves. [PARAGRAPH]Whereas most gods favor their worshipers, Amathaon shows no such partiality. He instead shows caprice, sharing his blessings seemingly at random. Most Creation Mages do not even know they are mages.
chinese: [TAB]你掌控的此类资源越多，你的奥术单位就越有可能被赋予 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CREATION]创造亲和[\\LINK]。此领域的独特之处在于，其亲和甚至可能被赋予毫无经验的 [LINK=UNIT_ADEPT]术士[\\LINK]，而非只留给那些已达 3 级并升级为魔法师者。它的另一独特之处在于，它没有任何可随单位升级、凭经验习得的晋升。它的法术没有低阶与高阶之分。[PARAGRAPH]创造亲和允许取用创造领域的法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MUSE]缪斯[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_PIXIE]召唤精灵[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_ABUNDANCE]丰饶[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_REJUVENATE]回春[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 IV[\\LINK]）[PARAGRAPH:2]对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_KURIOTATES]库里奥塔特[\\LINK] 文明、或信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]丰饶之家[\\LINK] 者而言，创造能量的有效供给更为充裕。而对信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]灰烬帷幕[\\LINK] 者——无论作为国教还是施法者个人的信仰——则会减少。[PARAGRAPH:2]创造是新生、诞生与灵感的领域。它关乎原创的构想，以及秩序意外地从创造性的混沌中涌现。太一本意让创造成为“希望”的补充。希望渴求某个特定的结果，驱使我们为之努力，若其目标看似遥不可及，则可能导向绝望。创造则更愿对意外的可能性保持开放，其结果往往胜过执著于我们自以为想要的东西。[PARAGRAPH]阿玛松掌管此领域。他是个温和的灵魂，热爱幼童，憎恶冲突。他本不愿卷入诸神之战，却深知自己领域的力量必须集结起来，以阻止阿加雷斯出于怨恨而毁灭埃瑞布斯。他不愿亲自作战，而是发明了那件定义了一个时代的大规模杀伤性武器：巨龙。其他诸神很快便效仿他，创造出许多这样的巨兽来为己效力，但无一能与 [LINK=UNIT_EURABATRES]金龙尤拉巴崔斯[\\LINK] 相比。这第一头真正的巨龙，是自太一造出众神本身以来所创造的最伟大的存在。[PARAGRAPH]与多数偏爱其信徒的神明不同，阿玛松毫无这般偏袒。相反，他反复无常，似乎随意地分施其祝福。多数创造魔法师甚至不知道自己是魔法师。

english: [TAB]Allows access to the Chaos sphere spells:[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SPELL_DANCE_OF_BLADES]Dance of Blades[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS1]Chaos I[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]Chaos Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]Channeling I[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_PIT_BEAST]Summon Pit Beast[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS2]Chaos II[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]Chaos Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]Channeling II[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WONDER]Wonder[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS]Chaos III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]Chaos Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK][NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MUTATION]Mutation[\\LINK] with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]Chaos Affinity[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]Channeling IV[\\LINK][PARAGRAPH][PARAGRAPH]The more sources of this Mana you control, the more likely your [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK] are to be gifted with [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]Affinity for this sphere[\\LINK]. That not only increases the unit's strength based on how much mana you control, but lets it learn more powerful versions of the spells in this sphere for free, without spending any xp to level up, so long as it has the proper Channeling promotions.[PARAGRAPH]The effective supply of Chaos Mana is greater for the [LINK=CIVILIZATION_DOVIELLO]Doviello[\\LINK] civilization or for those following [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\\LINK]. It is reduced for those following [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]The Order[\\LINK], either as a State Religion or as the caster's personal faith. [PARAGRAPH:2]Chaos was created to be the sphere of interpersonal Peace, but has become the sphere of Strife. Camulos's individualism was created to balance Junil's insistence that we conform to external authorities. He was always an Anarchist, but originally focused on preventing individuals from constraining the freedom of others. Now he prefers to free men from the constraints of conscience and insists that everyone has the right to abuse everyone else. He exercises little to no control even in own vault, which has become an eternal battleground where a myriad demons vie for ephemeral dominance. He has no organized religion, but there are several underground cults devoted to this God of War. He tends to answer prayers with curses. When his most famed worshiper during the Age of Magic, [LINK=UNIT_DUIN]Baron Duin Halfmorn[\\LINK], prayed to Camulos for more followers, he made him a Lycanthrope. Gods rarely release the souls they have claimed, but Camulos sent the souls of both Duin and [LINK=LEADER_CHARADON]Charadon[\\LINK] back to Erebus in the Age of Rebirth to cause more strife.
chinese: [TAB]允许取用混沌领域的法术：[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SPELL_DANCE_OF_BLADES]剑舞[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS1]混沌 I[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]混沌亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING1]引导 I[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_SUMMON_PIT_BEAST]召唤嗜血兽[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS2]混沌 II[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]混沌亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING2]引导 II[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_WONDER]奇迹[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHAOS]混沌 III[\\LINK] 或 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]混沌亲和[\\LINK]，以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK]）[NEWLINE][TAB][ICON_BULLET][LINK=SPELL_MUTATION]变异[\\LINK]（需 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]混沌亲和[\\LINK] 以及 [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING4]引导 IV[\\LINK]）[PARAGRAPH][PARAGRAPH]你掌控的此类能量来源越多，你的 [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]奥术单位[\\LINK] 就越有可能被赋予 [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_CHAOS]对该领域的亲和[\\LINK]。这不仅会依你掌控的能量多寡提升该单位的强度，还能让它免费习得该领域法术更强大的版本，无需耗费任何经验升级，只要它拥有相应的引导晋升即可。[PARAGRAPH]对 [LINK=CIVILIZATION_DOVIELLO]多维洛[\\LINK] 文明、或信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]纷争之子[\\LINK] 者而言，混沌能量的有效供给更为充裕。而对信奉 [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ORDER]秩序[\\LINK] 者——无论作为国教还是施法者个人的信仰——则会减少。[PARAGRAPH:2]混沌本被创造为掌管人际“和平”的领域，却已沦为掌管“纷争”的领域。卡姆罗斯的个人主义，本被创造出来以平衡朱尼尔坚持要我们服从外部权威的主张。他一向是个无政府主义者，但最初只专注于阻止个人限制他人的自由。如今他更愿把人们从良知的约束中解放出来，坚称人人都有权彼此欺凌。他即便在自己的宝库中也几乎全无掌控，那宝库已沦为一处永恒的战场，无数恶魔为转瞬即逝的支配权而争斗。他没有有组织的宗教，但有几个地下邪教崇奉这位战争之神。他往往以诅咒回应祈祷。魔法时代，当他最负盛名的信徒 [LINK=UNIT_DUIN]狼人杜因·哈夫蒙[\\LINK] 向卡姆罗斯祈求更多追随者时，他把杜因变成了一头狼人。诸神鲜少释放他们所占据的灵魂，但卡姆罗斯却在重生时代把杜因与 [LINK=LEADER_CHARADON]卡拉登[\\LINK] 二人的灵魂送回埃瑞布斯，以制造更多纷争。
